functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::Allocate
functions.signature: template<class T> static void* Simd::Allocator<T>::Allocate(size_t size, size_t align)
functions.description: Allocates a contiguous block of aligned raw memory. Intended for allocating buffers with a specific byte alignment, typically used for SIMD-friendly data. Memory allocated by this function must be released with Simd::Allocator<T>::Free.
requirements: size is the number of bytes to allocate (not element count).
align is the required byte alignment for the returned pointer; specific constraints (e.g., power-of-two) are not documented here.
The returned memory must be freed with Simd::Allocator<T>::Free.
Behavior on allocation failure is unknown (underlying SimdAllocate/Simd::Allocate semantics not documented in this header).

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::Free
functions.signature: template<class T> static void Simd::Allocator<T>::Free(void* ptr)
functions.description: Frees a block of aligned memory previously allocated by Simd::Allocator<T>::Allocate (or the underlying Simd allocation API).
requirements: ptr must be a pointer previously returned by Simd::Allocator<T>::Allocate (or compatible underlying Simd allocator).
Double-free and freeing foreign pointers are invalid; behavior is unspecified in this header.
Handling of nullptr is not documented.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::Align
functions.signature: template<class T> static size_t Simd::Allocator<T>::Align(size_t size, size_t align)
functions.description: Returns size adjusted up to satisfy the requested alignment. Useful to compute an aligned byte size for buffer allocations.
requirements: size is the original size in bytes.
align is the required byte alignment. Specific constraints (e.g., power-of-two) are not documented.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::Alignment
functions.signature: template<class T> static size_t Simd::Allocator<T>::Alignment()
functions.description: Returns the library’s recommended alignment for best performance on the current platform.
requirements: No arguments. The exact value depends on platform/build configuration.
Use this value when allocating with this allocator to maximize performance.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::address
functions.signature: template<class T> const T* Simd::Allocator<T>::address(const T& value) const
functions.description: Returns the address of a const reference value, equivalent to std::addressof(value). Provided to satisfy the STL allocator interface.
requirements: value must be a valid reference to an object of type T.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::allocate
functions.signature: template<class T> T* Simd::Allocator<T>::allocate(std::size_t size, const void* ptr = NULL)
functions.description: Allocates raw, aligned storage sufficient for size objects of type T using the allocator’s preferred alignment. The hint parameter is ignored. Conforms to the STL allocator interface.
requirements: size is the number of T objects to allocate; the total bytes requested are size * sizeof(T).
The returned memory must be released with Simd::Allocator<T>::deallocate.
Behavior on allocation failure is unknown (exception/NULL not documented here).
ptr is an optional allocation hint; it is ignored by this implementation.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::max_size
functions.signature: template<class T> std::size_t Simd::Allocator<T>::max_size() const
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of T objects that can theoretically be allocated by this allocator, based on size_t limits. Part of the STL allocator interface.
requirements: No preconditions.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::deallocate
functions.signature: template<class T> void Simd::Allocator<T>::deallocate(T* ptr, std::size_t size)
functions.description: Deallocates storage previously allocated with allocate. The size parameter is ignored. Part of the STL allocator interface.
requirements: ptr must be a pointer previously returned by Simd::Allocator<T>::allocate for a compatible T.
Must not be called more than once for the same allocation (no double free).
The size argument is not used but should correspond to the originally requested count for API compatibility.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::construct
functions.signature: template<class T, class U, class V> void Simd::Allocator<T>::construct(U* ptr, const V& value)
functions.description: Constructs an object of type U in-place at ptr by copy-constructing from value. Provided to satisfy pre-C++11 STL allocator interface requirements.
requirements: ptr must point to suitably aligned, uninitialized storage large enough to hold an object of type U.
value must be a valid object convertible to U.
ptr must not be null.

functions.name: Simd::Allocator<T>::destroy
functions.signature: template<class T, class U> void Simd::Allocator<T>::destroy(U* ptr)
functions.description: Calls the destructor of the object of type U located at ptr without deallocating memory. Part of the STL allocator interface.
requirements: ptr must point to a live object of type U previously constructed at that address.
ptr must not be null.
After destroy, memory remains allocated and may be reused or deallocated separately.

functions.name: Simd::operator==

functions.description: Compares two Simd::Allocator instances for equality. Always returns true, meaning all allocator instances are considered interchangeable.
requirements: No preconditions.

functions.name: Simd::operator!=
functions.signature: template<typename T1, typename T2> bool Simd::operator!=(const Allocator<T1>& a1, const Allocator<T2>& a2)
functions.description: Compares two Simd::Allocator instances for inequality. Always returns false, meaning all allocator instances are considered interchangeable.
requirements: No preconditions.

functions.name: Simd::Round
functions.signature: int Simd::Round(double value)
functions.description: Rounds a floating-point value to the nearest integer using halfway-away-from-zero semantics and returns it as int.
requirements: Input value can be any finite double; behavior for NaN/Inf follows usual C++ arithmetic conversions (result is implementation-defined or unspecified for NaN/Inf).
Result is truncated to int after rounding; callers should ensure the rounded value is within int range to avoid overflow/undefined behavior.

functions.name: Simd::Convert
functions.signature: template<class TD, class TS> TD Simd::Convert(TS src)
functions.description: Generic value conversion helper that casts a source value of type TS to destination type TD. There are specializations for converting float/double to ptrdiff_t that apply rounding (via Simd::Round) before casting.
requirements: TD and TS must be types for which a cast (static cast) from TS to TD is valid.
When TD is ptrdiff_t and TS is float or double, rounding is performed before conversion (halfway-away-from-zero).
Callers should ensure the converted value fits into TD to avoid overflow/undefined behavior.

functions.name: Simd::operator+

functions.name: Simd::operator-
functions.signature: template<typename T> Simd::Point<T> Simd::operator-(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)

functions.name: Simd::operator*
functions.signature: template<typename T> Simd::Point<T> Simd::operator*(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)
functions.description: Multiplies two points component-wise and returns the resulting point.
requirements: T must support operator* for multiplication of coordinates.

functions.name: Simd::operator/
functions.signature: template<typename T> Simd::Point<T> Simd::operator/(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)
functions.description: Divides two points component-wise and returns the resulting point.
requirements: T must support operator/ for division of coordinates.
p2.x and p2.y must not be zero to avoid division by zero.

functions.name: Simd::SquaredDistance
functions.signature: template<typename T> T Simd::SquaredDistance(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)
functions.description: Computes the squared Euclidean distance between two points: (dx*dx + dy*dy), avoiding a square root.
requirements: T must support subtraction, multiplication, and addition operations.
For integer T, potential overflow may occur for large coordinate differences; callers should ensure ranges are safe if overflow is a concern.

functions.name: Simd::Distance
functions.signature: template<typename T> double Simd::Distance(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)
functions.description: Computes the Euclidean distance between two points as sqrt((dx*dx + dy*dy)), returning double.
requirements: T must support subtraction, multiplication, and addition operations.
Requires math library linkage for sqrt if building separately (usually automatic).

functions.name: Simd::DotProduct
functions.signature: template<typename T> T Simd::DotProduct(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)
functions.description: Computes the dot product of two points: p1.x*p2.x + p1.y*p2.y.
requirements: T must support multiplication and addition operations.
Be aware of potential overflow with integral T; callers should ensure ranges are safe if overflow is a concern.

functions.name: Simd::CrossProduct
functions.signature: template<typename T> T Simd::CrossProduct(const Simd::Point<T>& p1, const Simd::Point<T>& p2)

functions.name: Simd::Pixel::Bgr24::At
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
static const Simd::Pixel::Bgr24& Simd::Pixel::Bgr24::At(const Simd::View<A>& view, ptrdiff_t col, ptrdiff_t row);
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the 24-bit BGR pixel at coordinates (col, row) in the given Simd::View. Intended for read-only random access to BGR pixels. Internally asserts that the view format is Bgr24 and indexes the pixel via Simd::At.
requirements: view.format must be Simd::View<A>::Bgr24 (enforced by assert).
col must be within [0, view.width) and row within [0, view.height) to avoid out-of-bounds access (implied by indexed access).
view must be a valid, initialized Simd::View<A> whose buffer covers the requested coordinates.
Returned reference remains valid only while the underlying view data remains valid and unchanged in memory layout.

functions.name: Simd::Pixel::Bgra32::At
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
static const Simd::Pixel::Bgra32& Simd::Pixel::Bgra32::At(const Simd::View<A>& view, ptrdiff_t col, ptrdiff_t row);
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the 32-bit BGRA pixel at (col, row) in the provided view for read-only access. Asserts the view format is Bgra32 and uses Simd::At for addressing.
requirements: view.format must be Simd::View<A>::Bgra32 (enforced by assert).
col must be within [0, view.width) and row within [0, view.height) to avoid out-of-bounds access.
view must be a valid, initialized Simd::View<A> with memory covering the coordinates.
Reference validity depends on the lifetime and stability of the view’s underlying buffer.

functions.name: Simd::View::ToTFTensor
functions.signature:
#ifdef SIMD_TENSORFLOW_ENABLE
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::View<A>::ToTFTensor(tensorflow::Tensor & tensor, float shift = 0, float scale = 1) const;
#endif
functions.description: Writes this image into a TensorFlow Tensor (no copy of underlying view), converting bytes to float with optional linear transform: value_out = (value_in + shift) * scale. Supports Bgr24, Bgra32, and Gray8 formats.
requirements: Requires SIMD_TENSORFLOW_ENABLE and TensorFlow headers/types available.
tensor must be a float tensor of rank 3 with shape [height, width, channels].
For Bgr24/Bgra32, tensor must have at least 3 channels; indices 0..2 are written (B,G,R).
For Gray8, tensor must have at least 1 channel; only channel 0 is written.
The view's format must be one of Bgr24, Bgra32, or Gray8; other formats are not handled by the implementation.
The view must have valid data, width, height, and stride.

uint8_t* Simd::View<A>::Release(size_t* size = NULL);
functions.description: Releases ownership of the pixel buffer and returns the raw pointer, optionally returning its byte size. The view is cleared and no longer owns or references the data.
requirements: If 'size' is non-null, it will receive DataSize() before clearing the view.
The returned pointer must be freed by ::SimdFree (as noted in comments).
After release, the view becomes empty (like Clear()).

functions.description: Returns true if this view currently owns the underlying pixel buffer; false if it references external data.

functions.name: Simd::View::Capture
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::View<A>::Capture(bool copy = true);
functions.description: If the view references external data (owner=false) and has valid data, converts it into an owning view. If copy=true, allocates internal storage and copies pixels; if copy=false, simply marks as owner without copying.
requirements: Only has effect when data is non-null and owner==false.
If copy=true, requires memory allocation for an internal buffer sized height*stride; data are copied row-by-row.
If copy=false, the external buffer must have been allocated in a way compatible with being freed by Allocator::Free() later, since the view will consider itself the owner after the call.

functions.signature:

const T & Simd::At(const Simd::View<A> & view, size_t x, size_t y);
functions.description: Free function to access a const reference to the pixel of type T at (x, y) in the given view.
requirements: 0 <= x < view.width and 0 <= y < view.height; otherwise an assertion may fail.
Type T must match the interpretation of the pixel data.
view.data must be non-null.

functions.name: Simd::EqualSize
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A, template<class> class B>
bool Simd::EqualSize(const Simd::View<A> & a, const Simd::View<B> & b);

requirements: None. Works across different allocator templates A and B.

functions.name: Simd::Compatible

template <template<class> class A, template<class> class B>
bool Simd::Compatible(const Simd::View<A> & a, const Simd::View<B> & b);

requirements: None. Formats are compared by casting b.format to a's Format type.

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Pyramid
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::Pyramid<A>::Pyramid()
functions.description: Default constructor for a gray 8-bit image pyramid container with no levels allocated. Use Recreate(...) to allocate levels before accessing images.
requirements: Object is empty after construction; callers must call Recreate(...) to allocate levels before using operator[], At(), or Top().
Do not call Top(), operator[] or At() until at least one level has been created (Size() > 0).

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Pyramid
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::Pyramid<A>::Pyramid(const Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& size, size_t levelCount)
functions.description: Constructs a pyramid with the specified base image size and number of levels. Each subsequent level’s size is computed by halving each dimension (rounding up) using Simd::Scale with scale=2. All levels are 8-bit grayscale (View<A>::Gray8).
requirements: levelCount should be greater than 0 to create at least one level (if 0, no levels are created and Top()/indexing would be invalid).
size.x and size.y should be non-negative dimensions.
Access to levels after construction must use indices in [0, Size()-1].

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Pyramid
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::Pyramid<A>::Pyramid(size_t width, size_t height, size_t levelCount)
functions.description: Constructs a pyramid with the specified base width/height and number of levels. Each level is half the size of the previous level (dimensions rounded up), and stored as 8-bit grayscale images.
requirements: levelCount should be greater than 0 to create at least one level (if 0, no levels are created and Top()/indexing would be invalid).
width and height should be non-zero to produce meaningful images (zero is technically accepted but yields empty dimensions at some levels).
Access to levels after construction must use indices in [0, Size()-1].

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Recreate
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::Pyramid<A>::Recreate(Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t> size, size_t levelCount)
functions.description: Re-initializes the pyramid to the given base size and number of levels. Allocates levelCount 8-bit grayscale images; each subsequent level is computed by halving each dimension (rounded up). If the pyramid already has levels and the requested base size equals the current base size, the call returns early without reallocating or changing the level count.
requirements: If levelCount is 0 the pyramid will have no levels; subsequent Top() or level access is invalid.
size.x and size.y should be non-negative dimensions.

Be aware: if the pyramid is already created and size equals the current base size, the function returns without changing the existing level count (this may be surprising); callers that need a different level count should ensure size differs or reconstruct a new object.
After recreation, valid indices are [0, Size()-1].

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Recreate
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::Pyramid<A>::Recreate(size_t width, size_t height, size_t levelCount)
functions.description: Convenience overload to re-initialize the pyramid using base width/height and level count. Levels are 8-bit grayscale and each subsequent level’s size is halved (rounded up).
requirements: If levelCount is 0 the pyramid will have no levels; subsequent Top() or level access is invalid.
width and height should be non-negative; zero may result in empty images.
If called with a base size equal to the current base size of an already-created pyramid, level count may remain unchanged due to early return behavior in the Point overload.

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Size
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
size_t Simd::Pyramid<A>::Size() const
functions.description: Returns the number of levels currently in the pyramid.

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::operator[]
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::View<A>& Simd::Pyramid<A>::operator[](size_t level)
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the image at the specified pyramid level.
requirements: level must be a valid index in the range [0, Size()-1]; no bounds checking is performed.
Pyramid must have been created (Size() > 0) before access.

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::operator[]

functions.description: Returns a const reference to the image at the specified pyramid level.
requirements: level must be a valid index in the range [0, Size()-1]; no bounds checking is performed.
Pyramid must have been created (Size() > 0) before access.

Simd::View<A>& Simd::Pyramid<A>::At(size_t level)
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the image at the specified pyramid level. Functionally equivalent to operator[].
requirements: level must be a valid index in the range [0, Size()-1]; no bounds checking is performed.
Pyramid must contain at least one level (Size() > 0).

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::At
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
const Simd::View<A>& Simd::Pyramid<A>::At(size_t level) const
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the image at the specified pyramid level. Functionally equivalent to operator[].
requirements: level must be a valid index in the range [0, Size()-1]; no bounds checking is performed.
Pyramid must contain at least one level (Size() > 0).

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Top
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::View<A>& Simd::Pyramid<A>::Top()
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the image at the top (last) level of the pyramid (the smallest image).

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Top
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
const Simd::View<A>& Simd::Pyramid<A>::Top() const
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the image at the top (last) level of the pyramid (the smallest image).
requirements: Pyramid must contain at least one level (Size() > 0).

functions.name: Simd::Pyramid::Swap
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::Pyramid<A>::Swap(Simd::Pyramid<A>& pyramid)
functions.description: Swaps the internal image levels with another Pyramid of the same template parameter. Efficiently exchanges contents without reallocating.
requirements: pyramid must be a Pyramid<A> using the same allocator template parameter A.

functions.name: Simd::Scale
functions.signature: Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t> Simd::Scale(Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t> size, int scale = 2)
functions.description: Scales an image size down by repeatedly halving each dimension scale/2 times (rounding up each time). Intended for computing pyramid level sizes.
requirements: scale must be >= 1.
scale must be a power of two; an internal assert requires scale to be even at each halving step.
size.x and size.y should be non-negative; negative dimensions are invalid for image sizes.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Frame
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>::Frame()
functions.description: Default constructor. Creates an empty frame with width=0, height=0, format=None, flipped=false, timestamp=0, yuvType=SimdYuvUnknown.
requirements: No requirements; constructs an empty, non-owning frame with no allocated planes.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Clone
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>* Simd::Frame<A>::Clone() const
functions.description: Deep-copies the entire frame into a newly allocated Frame with identical size, format, flipped flag, timestamp, and yuvType. Caller owns the returned pointer.
requirements: Caller must delete the returned pointer when done.
Source frame must have a valid non-None format for data to be copied (Copy is no-op for format==None).

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Clone
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>* Simd::Frame<A>::Clone(const Simd::Rectangle<ptrdiff_t>& rect) const
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep-copied sub-frame specified by rect. Internally Regions the frame to rect then clones it. Caller owns the returned pointer.
requirements: Caller must delete the returned pointer when done.
rect coordinates outside the frame are clamped; for subsampled formats (Nv12, Yuv420p) the region is expanded/rounded to even boundaries.
If the resulting region is empty or format==None, returns a clone of an empty frame.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Clone
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>* Simd::Frame<A>::Clone(Simd::Frame<A>& buffer) const
functions.description: Deep-copies the frame into the provided buffer’s storage (growing buffer planes as needed) and returns a non-owning Frame wrapper pointing at buffer’s memory. Caller owns the returned Frame object (but not its data).
requirements: buffer.planes[i] must be able to grow to at least the source plane sizes; function recreates them if smaller.
Caller must delete the returned Frame pointer but must not free the underlying buffer memory (owned by 'buffer').
Source and destination must be Compatible for Copy (same size/format/flipped/yuvType).

functions.name: Simd::Frame::operator=
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>& Simd::Frame<A>::operator=(const Simd::Frame<A>& frame)
functions.description: Copy-assignment. Makes this Frame reference the same planes as the source (no deep copy) and copies metadata.
requirements: Self-assignment is handled safely.
After assignment, both frames reference the same underlying plane buffers.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Ref
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A>& Simd::Frame<A>::Ref()
functions.description: Returns a reference to this Frame (utility for APIs expecting a reference-returning call).
requirements: No special requirements; returns *this.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Recreate
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Frame<A>::Recreate(size_t width_, size_t height_, Simd::Frame<A>::Format format_, ::SimdYuvType yuvType_ = ::SimdYuvUnknown)
functions.description: Re-initializes this Frame to the given size and format, (re)allocating internal plane buffers accordingly and resetting plane formats. yuvType is set/validated per format.
requirements: If format_ is Nv12 or Yuv420p, width_ and height_ must be even (asserts otherwise).
For YUV formats (Nv12, Yuv420p, Yuv444p) with yuvType_==SimdYuvUnknown, yuvType becomes SimdYuvBt601; for non-YUV formats, any non-unknown yuvType is coerced to SimdYuvUnknown.
All existing planes are cleared/recreated; previous contents are lost.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Recreate
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Frame<A>::Recreate(const Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& size, Simd::Frame<A>::Format format_, ::SimdYuvType yuvType_ = ::SimdYuvUnknown)
functions.description: Overload of Recreate using a Point for size.
requirements: Same requirements as the width/height overload apply (even sizes for subsampled formats, YUV type handling, planes recreated).

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(const ptrdiff_t& left, const ptrdiff_t& top, const ptrdiff_t& right, const ptrdiff_t& bottom) const
functions.description: Returns a new Frame that references a rectangular sub-region of this frame (no copy). Coordinates are clamped to frame bounds and adjusted for subsampled formats.
requirements: right must be >= left and bottom must be >= top; otherwise an empty Frame is returned.
For Nv12 and Yuv420p, region edges are aligned to even coordinates (left/top rounded down to even; right/bottom rounded up to even).
If format==None or region is invalid/empty, returns an empty Frame.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(ptrdiff_t& left, ptrdiff_t& top, ptrdiff_t& right, ptrdiff_t& bottom) const
functions.description: Like the coordinate Region overload, but updates the input parameters to the actual clamped/aligned region used. Returns a Frame referencing that region (no copy).
requirements: Initial right must be >= left and bottom must be >= top; otherwise an empty Frame is returned and parameters are unchanged.
For Nv12 and Yuv420p, coordinates are adjusted to even boundaries as described; outputs reflect the adjusted values.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(const Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& topLeft, const Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& bottomRight) const
functions.description: Region overload taking two corner points. Returns a Frame referencing the corresponding sub-region (no copy).
requirements: Same as the coordinate overload: bottomRight.x >= topLeft.x, bottomRight.y >= topLeft.y; coordinates are clamped and may be aligned for subsampled formats.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& topLeft, Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& bottomRight) const
functions.description: Region overload with in/out corner points. Adjusts the points to the actual clamped/aligned region and returns a Frame referencing it (no copy).
requirements: Same constraints as other Region overloads; points are updated to the actual region used.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(const Simd::Rectangle<ptrdiff_t>& rect) const
functions.description: Region overload taking a rectangle. Returns a Frame referencing the specified sub-rectangle (no copy).
requirements: rect must define a non-negative-width/height box; coordinates are clamped to the frame and aligned for subsampled formats.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Region
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Region(Simd::Rectangle<ptrdiff_t>& rect) const
functions.description: Region overload with in/out rectangle. Adjusts rect to the actual clamped/aligned region and returns a Frame referencing it (no copy).
requirements: Same constraints as other Region overloads; rect is updated to reflect the actual region used.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Flipped
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Frame<A> Simd::Frame<A>::Flipped() const
functions.description: Returns a new Frame referencing the same memory but vertically flipped. The flipped flag is toggled, and plane views are flipped; no pixel data is copied.
requirements: Source frame can have any valid format; returns an empty frame if source format==None.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Size
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t> Simd::Frame<A>::Size() const
functions.description: Returns the frame’s size as a Point<ptrdiff_t> (width, height).
requirements: None.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::DataSize
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> size_t Simd::Frame<A>::DataSize() const
functions.description: Returns the total byte size of all plane data by summing each plane’s DataSize.
requirements: None; returns 0 for empty planes.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Area
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> size_t Simd::Frame<A>::Area() const
functions.description: Returns the frame’s pixel area (width * height).
requirements: None; returns 0 if width or height is 0.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::PlaneCount
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> static size_t Simd::Frame<A>::PlaneCount(Simd::Frame<A>::Format format)
functions.description: Static utility: returns the number of planes required for the given frame format.
requirements: format must be a valid enumerator; passing an unknown value triggers an assert.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::PlaneCount
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> size_t Simd::Frame<A>::PlaneCount() const
functions.description: Returns the number of planes of this frame based on its format.
requirements: None; returns 0 if format==None.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Clear
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Frame<A>::Clear()
functions.description: Clears the frame: clears existing planes, resets width/height to 0, format to None, flipped=false, timestamp=0, yuvType=SimdYuvUnknown.
requirements: After Clear(), the frame becomes empty; any existing plane views are cleared.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Swap
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Frame<A>::Swap(Simd::Frame<A>& other)
functions.description: Swaps all planes and metadata with another frame, including deleter/context.
requirements: other must be a valid Simd::Frame instance; swapping with self is safe but a no-op.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Owner
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> bool Simd::Frame<A>::Owner() const
functions.description: Returns true if all planes are owners of their underlying images; false otherwise.
requirements: None.

functions.name: Simd::Frame::Capture
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Frame<A>::Capture()
functions.description: Ensures ownership of plane data by capturing/copying any non-owning planes into internal buffers.
requirements: None; operates on each existing plane.

functions.name: Simd::EqualSize
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A, template<class> class B> bool Simd::EqualSize(const Simd::Frame<A>& a, const Simd::Frame<B>& b)
functions.description: Returns true if two frames have identical width and height; false otherwise.
requirements: Frames may have different allocators A/B; only sizes are compared.

functions.name: Simd::Compatible
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A, template<class> class B> bool Simd::Compatible(const Simd::Frame<A>& a, const Simd::Frame<B>& b)
functions.description: Returns true if two frames are compatible: same width, height, format, flipped flag, and yuvType; false otherwise.
requirements: None beyond providing valid frames.

functions.name: Simd::Copy
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A, template<class> class B> void Simd::Copy(const Simd::Frame<A>& src, Simd::Frame<B>& dst)
functions.description: Copies pixel data plane-by-plane from src to dst. No-op if src.format==None.
requirements: src and dst must be Compatible (same width, height, format, flipped flag, yuvType) – asserted in code.
dst must have preallocated planes large enough to receive data.

functions.name: Simd::Convert
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void Simd::Convert(const Simd::Frame<A>& src, Simd::Frame<A>& dst)
functions.description: Converts between frame formats (color space/packing) with identical width and height. Handles many conversions among Gray/BGR(A)/RGB(A)/NV12/YUV420P/YUV444P/Lab24.
requirements: src and dst must have equal sizes and non-None formats, and must have the same flipped flag (asserted).
For YUV↔YUV and some YUV↔RGB conversions, src.yuvType must match dst.yuvType (asserted in branches that require it).
dst must have planes allocated to match the target format.

functions.name: Simd::Resize
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void Simd::Resize(const Simd::Frame<A>& src, Simd::Frame<A>& dst, ::SimdResizeMethodType method = ::SimdResizeMethodBilinear)
functions.description: Resizes src into dst using the specified resampling method. If sizes match, performs a Copy; otherwise it uses internal resizers per plane (including handling subsampled chroma when applicable).
requirements: src.format must equal dst.format and must not be None (asserted).
dst must be precreated with the desired target size/format, or use the size overload.
For Nv12/Yuv420p, chroma planes are resized with a half-resolution resizer; for Yuv444p, all three planes are resized with the main resizer.
method must be a valid ::SimdResizeMethodType; SimdResizerInit must succeed (asserts if it fails).

functions.name: Simd::Resize
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void Simd::Resize(const Simd::Frame<A>& src, Simd::Frame<A>& dst, const Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>& size, ::SimdResizeMethodType method = ::SimdResizeMethodBilinear)
functions.description: Convenience resize that ensures dst has the requested size (creating or replacing as needed) and then resizes src into dst using the given method. If src and dst are the same object and size differs, resizes via a temporary.
requirements: If &src == &dst and size differs, a temporary Frame(size, src.format) must be creatable to hold the resized result.
When &src != &dst and dst.Size()!=size, dst is recreated with src.format before resizing.
method must be a valid ::SimdResizeMethodType.

functions.name: Simd::DrawLine
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawLine(View<A> & canvas, ptrdiff_t x1, ptrdiff_t y1, ptrdiff_t x2, ptrdiff_t y2, const Color & color, size_t width = 1)
functions.description: Draw a straight line on the given image canvas from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) with the specified pixel color and line width. This is a C++ wrapper around the C API SimdDrawLine and forwards raw image buffer parameters. Use when you need to render line segments onto a Simd::View image with a pixel type matching Color.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).
width must be a positive integer (default 1).
Coordinates x1,y1,x2,y2 are integer positions; behavior for coordinates outside the canvas is handled by the underlying SimdDrawLine (clipping specifics are not documented here).

functions.name: Simd::DrawRectangle
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawRectangle(View<A>& canvas, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, const Color& color, size_t width = 1)
functions.description: Draw the outline (frame) of a rectangle on the image canvas with the given color and frame width. This is a C++ wrapper around SimdDrawRectangle and passes raw buffer parameters.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).
width must be a positive integer (default 1).
Caller should provide rectangle bounds with left <= right and top <= bottom; no reordering is performed in this wrapper.
Coordinates may lie outside the canvas; clipping, if any, is handled by SimdDrawRectangle (not specified here).

functions.name: Simd::DrawFilledRectangle
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawFilledRectangle(View<A> & canvas, Rectangle<ptrdiff_t> rect, const Color & color)
functions.description: Fill the given rectangle area on the image canvas with the specified pixel color. For pixel sizes up to 4 bytes it uses Simd::FillPixel over the clipped region; otherwise it manually fills scanlines after clipping rect to the canvas bounds.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
rect can be any coordinates; it is clipped to the canvas internally (rect &= Rectangle<ptrdiff_t>(canvas.Size())).
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).

functions.name: Simd::DrawPolygon
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawPolygon(View<A> & canvas, const std::vector<Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>> & polygon, const Color & color, size_t width = 1)
functions.description: Draw the outline of a polygon on the image canvas by connecting consecutive vertices and closing the shape (last vertex to first). Uses DrawLine for each edge.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
polygon must contain at least 1 point; empty vectors will cause undefined behavior via polygon.back().
For meaningful polygon outlines, provide at least 2 points; with 1 point no segments are drawn.
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).
width must be a positive integer (default 1).

functions.name: Simd::DrawFilledPolygon
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawFilledPolygon(View<A> & canvas, const std::vector<Simd::Point<ptrdiff_t>> & polygon, const Color & color)
functions.description: Fill the interior of a polygon on the image canvas using a scanline approach: computes edge intersections per row, sorts them, and fills between pairs. The polygon is treated as closed (last vertex connects to first).
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
polygon must contain at least 1 point; empty vectors will cause undefined behavior via polygon.back().
For a meaningful filled area, provide at least 3 points (degenerate polygons may result in no fill).
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).

functions.name: Simd::DrawEllipse
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawEllipse(View<A> & canvas, const Point<ptrdiff_t> & center, const Point<ptrdiff_t> & axes, double slope, const Color & color, size_t width = 1)
functions.description: Draw the outline of an ellipse on the image canvas centered at 'center' with semi-axes given by 'axes' (x and y radii) rotated by 'slope' radians. The ellipse is approximated by many short line segments via DrawLine.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
axes.x and axes.y should be non-negative radii; negative values are nonsensical and may produce unexpected results.
slope is in radians (used with std::sin/std::cos).
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).
width must be a positive integer (default 1).

functions.name: Simd::DrawCircle
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A, class Color> SIMD_INLINE void DrawCircle(View<A> & canvas, const Point<ptrdiff_t> & center, ptrdiff_t radius, const Color & color, size_t width = 1)
functions.description: Draw the outline of a circle on the image canvas centered at 'center' with the given radius. The circle is approximated by line segments using DrawLine.
requirements: canvas must reference a valid image; canvas.PixelSize() must equal sizeof(Color) (asserted).
radius should be non-negative; negative values are nonsensical and may produce unexpected results.
color must represent a pixel value compatible with the canvas pixel format (size exactly sizeof(Color)).
width must be a positive integer (default 1).

functions.name: Simd::Font::Font
functions.signature: Simd::Font::Font(size_t height = 16)
functions.description: Constructs a Simd::Font object with a given pixel height. Internally initializes a font rendering context and, if successful, sets the initial height. The font supports ASCII characters only and is based on a generic monospace font. Use this constructor before calling Measure/Draw methods.
requirements: height is a size in pixels (type size_t).
Only ASCII characters are supported by this font (text containing non-ASCII may not render as expected).
Successful internal initialization is required for subsequent operations; if initialization fails, later calls like Resize/Measure/Draw may return default values/false.

functions.name: Simd::Font::~Font
functions.signature: Simd::Font::~Font()
functions.description: Destructor for Simd::Font. Releases any internal font rendering context/resources held by the instance.
requirements: No special caller requirements; ensure the object is not used after destruction.

functions.name: Simd::Font::Resize
functions.signature: bool Simd::Font::Resize(size_t height)
functions.description: Changes the font height in pixels. Returns true on success and false if the internal context is unavailable or the operation fails.
requirements: height is a size in pixels (type size_t).
Only callable on a constructed Simd::Font instance; if internal initialization failed, the function returns false.
Check the boolean return value to ensure the resize succeeded before using the new size.

functions.name: Simd::Parallel
functions.signature: template<class Function> inline void Simd::Parallel(size_t begin, size_t end, const Function& function, size_t threadNumber, size_t blockAlign = 1)
functions.description: Partitions the half-open range [begin, end) into blocks and invokes the user-provided callable potentially in parallel (via std::async) on each block. The callable is invoked as function(threadIndex, blockBegin, blockEnd). The number of blocks is derived from threadNumber (clamped to hardware_concurrency). If SIMD_FUTURE_DISABLE is defined, it runs single-threaded as function(0, begin, end). Blocks are sized to cover the range and then rounded up to a multiple of blockAlign; all but possibly the first block are clamped to end in this implementation. Use to parallelize range-based work with optional block alignment. Notes: exceptions thrown inside tasks are not propagated (futures are only waited, not retrieved).
requirements: begin and end define a valid half-open range: begin <= end.
function must be callable with the signature: void(size_t threadIndex, size_t blockBegin, size_t blockEnd).
function must be safe for concurrent execution across disjoint subranges (no data races on shared state unless externally synchronized).
threadNumber is a non-negative size_t; values <= 1 (or if the range is too small) will execute the callable once on the whole range.

blockAlign must be >= 1. Because block sizes are rounded up to a multiple of blockAlign, the first blockEnd may exceed end if (end - begin) is not a multiple of blockAlign; the callable must tolerate receiving a blockEnd beyond the true range (e.g., internally clamp to end or ensure (end - begin) is divisible by blockAlign).

The callable should not rely on exceptions for error reporting when running in parallel; exceptions thrown inside tasks will be captured by std::future but are never retrieved (only waited), so they will be effectively ignored.
The callable must not assume any particular mapping of threadIndex to OS threads or scheduling order.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::ShiftDetector
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::ShiftDetector()
functions.description: Default-constructs a ShiftDetector with no allocated context or buffers. Texture type defaults to TextureGray and difference type to AbsDifference. Use InitBuffers (and then SetBackground) before calling Estimate.

Before using Estimate or SetBackground, the caller must call InitBuffers to create an internal context.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::~ShiftDetector
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::~ShiftDetector()
functions.description: Destructor. Releases the internal native detector context if it was created by InitBuffers.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.
No exceptions are thrown by the destructor (not explicitly stated, but body only releases context).

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::InitBuffers
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::InitBuffers(const typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::Point & frameSize,
                                         size_t levelCount,
                                         typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::TextureType textureType = Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::TextureGray,
                                         typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::DifferenceType differenceType = Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::AbsDifference)
functions.description: Initializes or re-initializes internal buffers and native context for a given background frame size and pyramid level count. Also sets the texture and difference modes used during shift estimation.
requirements: frameSize specifies the full background image dimensions; subsequent background images passed to SetBackground must exactly match this size.
levelCount is the number of pyramid levels; must be suitable for the underlying implementation (not explicitly range-checked here).
May be called multiple times; previous context will be released and replaced.
Must be successfully called before SetBackground or Estimate.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::SetBackground
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::SetBackground(const typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::View & background,
                                           bool makeCopy = true)
functions.description: Sets the background image used as the reference for shift estimation. Optionally makes an internal copy of the image.
requirements: InitBuffers must have been called successfully beforehand (internal context must exist).
background.Size() must equal the frameSize passed to InitBuffers.
background.format must be View::Gray8 (grayscale 8-bit).
If makeCopy is true, the function copies the background; otherwise it references the provided data for the lifetime required by the detector.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::Estimate
functions.description: Estimates the shift of a current image patch relative to the previously set background image, starting the search from a specified background region. The search is limited by the per-axis maxShift and can be penalized near borders using hiddenAreaPenalty.
requirements: InitBuffers must be called before, and a background must be set via SetBackground.
current.Size() must equal region.Size().
region.Area() must be > 0 and >= regionAreaMin; otherwise the function returns false.
The internal frame size must be non-zero and at least as large as current (frameSize.x >= current.width and frameSize.y >= current.height).
maxShift specifies maximum allowed shift along X and Y axes (components used as-is).
hiddenAreaPenalty is a pointer-backed parameter internally; pass finite double values.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::Shift
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::Point Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::Shift() const
functions.description: Returns the last estimated integer shift of the current image relative to the background. If no context exists or no estimate was performed, returns a default-initialized Point.
requirements: Meaningful value only after a successful call to Estimate.
Function is const and does not modify state.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::RefinedShift
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
typename Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::FPoint Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::RefinedShift() const
functions.description: Returns the last estimated refined shift with sub-pixel accuracy. If no context exists or no estimate was performed, returns a default-initialized FPoint.
requirements: Meaningful value only after a successful call to Estimate that computed a shift.
Function is const and does not modify state.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::Stability
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
double Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::Stability() const
functions.description: Returns a stability (reliability) metric of the last estimated shift.
requirements: Meaningful value only after a successful call to Estimate.
Function is const and does not modify state.

functions.name: Simd::ShiftDetector::Correlation
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
double Simd::ShiftDetector<A>::Correlation() const
functions.description: Returns the best correlation value between the background and current image for the last estimation.
requirements: Meaningful value only after a successful call to Estimate.
Function is const and does not modify state.

functions.name: Simd::ContourDetector::Init
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
void Simd::ContourDetector<A>::Init(Size size)
functions.description: Prepares a ContourDetector instance to work with images of the given size by allocating/recreating its internal working buffers. Expected usage: call once (or whenever image size changes) before Detect so that internal buffers match the input image size and formats used during detection. Details about allocator and internal formats are handled by the class; callers only provide the target size.
requirements: Must be called before Detect for a given image size; otherwise Detect may return false due to incompatible buffers.
The provided size should match the size of images passed later to Detect; mismatched sizes will make Detect return false.
Size components should be non-negative and represent a valid image extent (inferred from typical image handling and internal buffer recreation).

functions.name: Simd::ContourDetector::Detect
functions.signature:
template <template<class> class A>
bool Simd::ContourDetector<A>::Detect(const View & src, Contours & contours, const View & mask = View(), uint8_t indexMin = 3, const Rect & roi = Rect(), int gradientThreshold = 40, int anchorThreshold = 0, int anchorScanInterval = 2, int minSegmentLength = 2)
functions.description: Detects contours in the input image and outputs them as polylines (sequences of points). Optionally restricts processing by a mask image and/or an ROI rectangle. If gradientThreshold is negative, an adaptive threshold is estimated from the image. Anchors are found and routed to assemble contours; segments shorter than minSegmentLength are discarded. Usage: after Init(size), pass a Gray8 source image (same size as Init), optionally a Gray8 mask (same size), and collect the resulting contours. Returns true on successful detection, or false if input compatibility checks fail.
requirements: Init(size) must have been called earlier with the same image size to prepare internal buffers; otherwise this function returns false.
src must be compatible with the detector’s internal buffers: same size as provided to Init and Gray8 format (inferred from checks against _a which is Gray8).
If mask is provided (mask.format != View::None), it must be Gray8 and the same size as src; otherwise the function returns false.
roi, if provided, is intersected with the image bounds; processing occurs only within this region.
If gradientThreshold < 0, the function will compute an adaptive threshold automatically; non-negative values are used as provided.
anchorScanInterval must be a positive integer (> 0); zero or negative values would cause invalid iteration (inferred from internal loops that increment by anchorScanInterval).
Callers must check the boolean return value; on false, input incompatibility occurred and output contours should not be used.

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Empty
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
bool Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Empty() const;
functions.description: Returns true if the ImageMatcher has not been initialized (no internal matcher allocated). Typical usage: check before calling Create/Find/Add to ensure Init() has been called.
requirements: None beyond a valid ImageMatcher instance. This function is const and does not modify state.

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Size
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
size_t Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Size() const;
functions.description: Returns the total number of images (hashes) added to the matcher. If the matcher is not initialized, returns 0.
requirements: None beyond a valid ImageMatcher instance. Safe to call before Init(); it will return 0 if uninitialized.

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Init
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
bool Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Init(double threshold = 0.05,
                                              typename Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::HashType type = Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Hash16x16,
                                              size_t number = 0,
                                              bool normalized = false);
functions.description: Initializes the ImageMatcher with similarity threshold, hash resolution, an estimated number of images, and whether images are histogram-normalized. Must be called before creating hashes or performing searches. Internally selects a matching strategy based on the inputs.
requirements: Must be called (and succeed) before Create(), Find(), Add(), or Skip().
threshold is a non-negative double representing a maximum normalized mean-squared difference; typical expected range is [0.0, 1.0] (inferred from usage).
type must be one of {Hash16x16, Hash32x32, Hash64x64}.
If the library selects the 3D matcher (internally used when number >= 10000 and threshold < 0.10), the threshold must be < 0.10 (enforced by selection logic).
number is an estimate used for internal allocation; it may be 0.
normalized indicates whether input images already have normalized histograms; affects internal binning (no other caller constraints).

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Create
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
typename Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::HashPtr
Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Create(const typename Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::View & view,
                                           const Tag & tag);
functions.description: Builds a hash for the given image to be used for matching. Converts non-Gray8 inputs to Gray8 and resizes to the configured hash size; also computes a coarser 'fast' hash. The returned shared pointer should be kept and later passed to Add() and/or Find().
requirements: Init() must have been successfully called prior to Create(); otherwise internal matcher data is null and behavior is undefined.
view must reference a valid image; any format is accepted, but non-Gray8 images will be converted internally.
The produced HashPtr is sized according to the current matcher settings; it should only be used with the same ImageMatcher instance that created it.

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Find
functions.description: Searches for similar images previously added to the matcher using the provided hash. Populates results with matches (each containing a pointer to the matched hash and the mean squared difference). Returns true if any matches are found. The results vector is cleared at the start.
requirements: Init() must have been successfully called prior to Find().
hash must be non-null and created by the same ImageMatcher instance (so that internal sizes/parameters match).
results is an output parameter and will be cleared on entry; caller must not rely on its prior contents.
If either the query hash or any candidate hash has been marked skipped via Skip(), such pairs are ignored.

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Add
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
void Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Add(const typename Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::HashPtr & hash);
functions.description: Adds an image hash to the matcher’s internal index so it can be found by future Find() calls.
requirements: Init() must have been successfully called prior to Add().
hash must be non-null and created by the same ImageMatcher instance (so that internal sizes/parameters match).

functions.name: Simd::ImageMatcher::Skip
functions.signature:
template <class Tag, template<class> class Allocator>
void Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Skip(const typename Simd::ImageMatcher<Tag, Allocator>::Hash * hash);
functions.description: Marks a specific hash as skipped so that comparisons involving it return no match. Useful to exclude certain images from search without removing them.
requirements: hash must be a non-null pointer to a Hash previously created by this ImageMatcher instance.
Intended to be called after Create(); calling before Init()/Create() is meaningless.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvifX
functions.signature: double Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvifX(ptrdiff_t x, ptrdiff_t screenWidth)
functions.description: Converts a screen-space X coordinate to an ONVIF X coordinate in the normalized range [-1, 1]. Usage: supply the pixel X position and the screen width; the function returns a double in ONVIF space.

functions.signature: double Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvifY(ptrdiff_t y, ptrdiff_t screenHeight)
functions.description: Converts a screen-space Y coordinate to an ONVIF Y coordinate in the normalized range [-1, 1], with the conventional image-space origin at the top-left (positive Y down). Usage: provide pixel Y and screen height; returns double in ONVIF space.
requirements: screenHeight must be > 0 to avoid division by zero.
y is expected to be in [0, screenHeight-1], otherwise the returned ONVIF value may be outside [-1, 1].

functions.name: Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvif
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::FPoint Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvif(const Simd::Motion::Point & point, const Simd::Motion::Point & screenSize)
functions.description: Converts a 2D screen-space point (x,y) to ONVIF normalized coordinates (x,y). Internally uses ScreenToOnvifX/Y.
requirements: screenSize.x and screenSize.y must be > 0 to avoid division by zero.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvifSize
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::FSize Simd::Motion::ScreenToOnvifSize(const Simd::Motion::Size & size, const Simd::Motion::Point & screenSize)
functions.description: Converts a 2D size in pixels (width,height) into ONVIF size units where full-screen equals 2.0 in each dimension. Returns values typically in [0, 2].

functions.name: Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenX
functions.signature: ptrdiff_t Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenX(double x, ptrdiff_t screenWidth)
functions.description: Converts an ONVIF X coordinate to a clamped screen-space X pixel index in [0, screenWidth-1]. Values outside [-1,1] are rounded and then clamped into the valid pixel range.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenY
functions.signature: ptrdiff_t Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenY(double y, ptrdiff_t screenHeight)
functions.description: Converts an ONVIF Y coordinate to a clamped screen-space Y pixel index in [0, screenHeight-1]. Values outside [-1,1] are rounded and then clamped.
requirements: screenHeight must be > 0 for a valid pixel range.
y is documented as ONVIF and restricted to [-1, 1], but the function clamps out-of-range values.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreen
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::Point Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreen(const Simd::Motion::FPoint & point, const Simd::Motion::Point & screenSize)
functions.description: Converts an ONVIF 2D point (x,y) to a clamped screen-space pixel point using OnvifToScreenX/Y.
requirements: screenSize.x and screenSize.y must be > 0 for valid pixel ranges.
Input ONVIF coordinates are documented as restricted to [-1, 1] but will be clamped if outside.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenSize
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::Size Simd::Motion::OnvifToScreenSize(const Simd::Motion::FSize & size, const Simd::Motion::Point & screenSize)
functions.description: Converts an ONVIF size (width,height), documented to be in [0,2], to a screen-space size in pixels by scaling with screen dimensions.
requirements: screenSize.x and screenSize.y must be > 0 to avoid division by zero.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::ToString
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::String Simd::Motion::ToString(Simd::Motion::Id id)
functions.description: Converts an object Id (int) to its string representation. Utility for annotations and logging.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::Detector::Detector
functions.signature: Simd::Motion::Detector::Detector()
functions.description: Default constructor for the motion Detector. Initializes internal state; options use library defaults until changed.

functions.name: Simd::Motion::Detector::~Detector
functions.signature: virtual Simd::Motion::Detector::~Detector()
functions.description: Virtual destructor for Detector. Cleans up resources owned by the detector instance.
requirements: Ensure no concurrent calls into this instance during destruction (thread-safety not documented).

functions.name: Simd::Motion::Detector::SetOptions
functions.signature: bool Simd::Motion::Detector::SetOptions(const Simd::Motion::Options & options)
functions.description: Sets motion detection options (calibration, difference/segmentation/tracking/classification parameters, and optional debug settings). Always returns true; the detector copies the provided options.
requirements: Options.SegmentationCreateThreshold must be in [0, 1] (as documented).
Options.SegmentationExpandCoefficient must be in [0, 1] (as documented).
Options.StabilityRegionAreaMax must be in [0, 1] (as documented).
Background/Timing fields represent seconds and should be non-negative to be meaningful (implied by documentation).
DebugDrawBottomRight valid values: 0 (empty), 1 (difference), 2 (texture.gray.value), 3 (texture.dx.value), 4 (texture.dy.value) as documented.
