functions.name: Simd::Motion::Detector::SetModel
functions.signature: bool Simd::Motion::Detector::SetModel(const Simd::Motion::Model & model)
functions.description: Sets the scene model used for algorithm calibration (object size and ROI via polygon or mask). The detector copies the provided model. Returns true.
requirements: Model.size (ONVIF size) is documented to be in [0, 2].
Model.roi coordinates (ONVIF) are documented to be in [-1, 1] each.
If Model.mask is provided, it must be an 8-bit gray image (format View::Gray8); otherwise the ROI polygon is used.
If ROI polygon has fewer than 3 points, the default full-screen ROI is assumed internally (per Model constructor behavior).

functions.name: Simd::Motion::Detector::NextFrame
functions.signature: bool Simd::Motion::Detector::NextFrame(const Simd::Motion::Frame & input, Simd::Motion::Metadata & metadata, Simd::Motion::Frame * output = NULL)
functions.description: Processes the next frame for motion detection. Produces Metadata with detected objects and events; optionally writes a debug-annotated frame to output. Must be called sequentially on all frames of a stream for correct tracking and background modeling.
requirements: If output is non-null, output->Size() must equal input.Size(); otherwise the function returns false.
Caller should process frames successively in temporal order for correct behavior (explicitly documented).
Input frame must be a valid Simd::Motion::Frame; timestamp (input.timestamp) should be set for time-based logic (grow/update/background/tracking).
The detector must be calibrated internally; calibration is performed automatically on first differing frame size. If calibration fails (rare/unknown conditions), the function returns false.
Not thread-safe per instance unless externally synchronized (not documented).

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Layer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::Layer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) = 0
functions.description: Abstract interface used by all layers to execute forward propagation on a single thread. The input vector src must match this layer’s expected input shape; results are stored in the layer’s internal thread-local output buffer (accessible via Dst(thread)).
requirements: Must be called on a concrete derived layer instance (pure virtual in Layer).
thread must be a valid worker index previously configured via SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal the layer’s expected input volume (this->_src.Volume()).
method must be a valid Layer::Method value; derived layers may use it to select fast/check/train paths.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Layer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::Layer::Backward(const Vector & src, size_t thread) = 0
functions.description: Abstract interface for backpropagation on a single thread. The input src is the delta (gradient) at this layer’s output; the layer computes gradients w.r.t. parameters and the previous layer’s activations into internal buffers (prevDelta, dWeight, dBias).
requirements: Must be called on a concrete derived layer instance (pure virtual in Layer).
thread must be a valid worker index configured with SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal this layer’s output volume (this->_dst.Volume()).
Caller should have run Forward beforehand for the same thread, as Backward uses previous activations.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Layer::FanSrc
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::Layer::FanSrc() const = 0
functions.description: Abstract query returning the fan-in (number of inputs contributing to one neuron) for weight initialization and regularization logic.
requirements: Must be implemented by derived layers; callable on a valid layer object.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Layer::FanDst
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::Layer::FanDst() const = 0
functions.description: Abstract query returning the fan-out (number of outputs a neuron connects to) for weight initialization and related logic.
requirements: Must be implemented by derived layers; callable on a valid layer object.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Layer::SetThreadNumber
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::Layer::SetThreadNumber(size_t number, bool train)
functions.description: Allocates and sizes per-thread working buffers (sum, dst, and when train==true also dWeight, dBias, prevDelta) for this layer.
requirements: number must be >= 1.
train==true allocates/initializes gradient buffers; ensure weights/biases are already sized.
Should be called before multi-threaded Forward/Backward calls; the same thread index must be used consistently.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::ConvolutionalLayer
functions.signature: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::ConvolutionalLayer(Function::Type f, const Size & srcSize, size_t srcDepth, size_t dstDepth, const Size & coreSize, bool valid = true, bool bias = true, const View & connection = View())
functions.description: Constructs a convolutional layer with given activation, input dimensions, number of output channels, kernel size, padding mode (valid or same), optional bias, and an optional connection map between input and output channels. Sets up optimized kernel paths for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 cores when available.
requirements: srcSize.x and srcSize.y must be non-negative; srcDepth and dstDepth must be > 0.
coreSize.x and coreSize.y must be > 0; selects fast paths only for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5.
If valid==true, output spatial size is reduced by (coreSize-1); if false, input is zero-padded and output size equals input size.
If a connection View is provided, it must be Compatible() with the internal map (dstDepth x srcDepth, Gray8). Otherwise full connectivity is used.
If bias==true, a bias vector of size dstDepth is allocated.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) override
functions.description: Computes the convolution for each connected input-output channel pair, adds bias (if present), and applies the configured activation function. Uses optimized SIMD kernels when possible; otherwise falls back to a generic implementation. Handles implicit input padding when valid==false.
requirements: thread must be a valid index configured by SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal _src.Volume(); internally padded when valid==false.
When a partial connection map is used, only connections marked non-zero are computed.
Bias vector is optional; if present, it must have size == _dst.depth.
Output is written to the layer’s per-thread dst buffer.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::Backward(const Vector & currDelta, size_t thread) override
functions.description: Backpropagates gradients through the convolution: computes prevDelta w.r.t. the previous layer’s outputs (respecting padding mode), accumulates dWeight and dBias, and applies the previous layer’s activation derivative to prevDelta. Uses optimized SIMD kernels for supported core sizes.
requirements: thread must be a valid index configured by SetThreadNumber(true).
currDelta.size() must equal _dst.Volume().
For valid==false, prevDelta is accumulated into a padded buffer then unpadded to match previous layer’s shape.
Requires that the previous layer’s forward activations for this thread are available for activation derivative and dWeight accumulation.
dWeight size must equal _core.Volume(); dBias (if present) size must equal _dst.depth.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::FanSrc
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::FanSrc() const override
functions.description: Returns the fan-in for this convolutional layer: core.width * core.height * src.depth.
requirements: Callable after construction; depends on configured core and src depth.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::FanDst
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::FanDst() const override
functions.description: Returns the fan-out for this convolutional layer: core.width * core.height * dst.depth.
requirements: Callable after construction; depends on configured core and dst depth.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::SetThreadNumber
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::ConvolutionalLayer::SetThreadNumber(size_t number, bool train) override
functions.description: Extends Layer::SetThreadNumber by allocating per-thread specific buffers for convolution (paddedSrc/paddedDelta when valid==false, temporary buffer for optimized kernel).
requirements: number must be >= 1.
If train==true and valid==false, paddedDelta is allocated.
Must be called before multi-threaded use; thread indices must be < number.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::MaxPoolingLayer
functions.signature: Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::MaxPoolingLayer(Function::Type f, const Size & srcSize, size_t srcDepth, const Size & poolingSize, const Size & poolingStride, const Size & poolingPad = Size())
functions.description: Constructs a max-pooling layer with given activation, input size/depth, window size, stride, and padding. Sets up specialized SIMD kernels for common configurations (2x2/stride2/no pad and 3x3/stride2/no pad).
requirements: srcDepth > 0; srcSize components non-negative.
poolingSize components > 0; poolingStride components > 0; poolingPad components >= 0.
Output size is computed as (src - pool + 2*stride + 2*pad - 1)/stride per dimension.
Specialized kernels are used only for supported size/stride/pad combos; otherwise generic path is used.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) override
functions.description: Performs max-pooling over each input channel. In Train or when an optimized kernel is unavailable, also records argmax indices for backprop; always applies the configured activation to the pooled result.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal _src.Volume().
If method != Layer::Train and a specialized kernel is available, fast path is used; otherwise generic path with index recording is used.
The layer must have had SetThreadNumber called with train==true to allocate index buffers when needed.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::Backward(const Vector & currDelta, size_t thread) override
functions.description: Backpropagates through max pooling by routing each delta to the position of the recorded maximum (argmax) and then applies the previous layer’s activation derivative.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber(true).
currDelta.size() must equal _dst.Volume().
Argmax index buffer must be initialized (from Forward in training/generic mode).
Previous layer’s forward outputs must be available for applying the activation derivative.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::SetThreadNumber
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::MaxPoolingLayer::SetThreadNumber(size_t number, bool train) override
functions.description: Allocates per-thread argmax index buffers when training or when no optimized forward kernel is available; otherwise defers to base allocation.
requirements: number must be >= 1.
When train==true or no fast kernel is configured, allocates index buffers of size _dst.Volume() per thread.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::AveragePoolingLayer
functions.signature: Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::AveragePoolingLayer(Function::Type f, const Size & srcSize, size_t srcDepth, const Size & poolingSize, const Size & poolingStride, const Size & poolingPad = Size())
functions.description: Constructs an average-pooling layer with given activation, input size/depth, window size, stride, and padding. Precomputes a scale factor of 1/(poolingSize.x*poolingSize.y).
requirements: srcDepth > 0; srcSize components non-negative.
poolingSize components > 0; poolingStride components > 0; poolingPad components >= 0.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) override
functions.description: Computes average pooling over each input channel using the specified window/stride/pad, writes pooled sums scaled by the precomputed factor, and applies the configured activation.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal _src.Volume().

functions.name: Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::AveragePoolingLayer::Backward(const Vector & currDelta, size_t thread) override
functions.description: Backpropagates through average pooling by distributing each output delta evenly (scaled) over the corresponding input window, then applies the previous layer’s activation derivative.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber(true).
currDelta.size() must equal _dst.Volume().
Previous layer’s forward outputs must be available to apply the activation derivative.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FullyConnectedLayer
functions.signature: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FullyConnectedLayer(Function::Type f, size_t srcSize, size_t dstSize, bool bias = true)
functions.description: Constructs a fully connected (inner-product) layer with given activation, input length, output length, and optional bias. Optionally uses reordered weights for fast forward path.
requirements: srcSize > 0; dstSize > 0.
If bias==true, allocates a bias vector of length dstSize.
Weights are sized dstSize*srcSize.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::~FullyConnectedLayer
functions.signature: virtual Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::~FullyConnectedLayer()
functions.description: Virtual destructor for FullyConnectedLayer. No special behavior beyond default cleanup.
requirements: Object must have been created via the corresponding constructor.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) override
functions.description: Computes y = W*x (+ b), optionally using a fast reordered layout or generic accumulation, then applies the configured activation. The fast path may reorder weights once under a mutex when method==Fast.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal _src.width (input length).
If method==Fast and reordering has not occurred, the layer may reorder weights internally once; subsequent calls assume that layout.
Bias vector is optional; if present, size must equal _dst.width (output length).

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::Backward(const Vector & currDelta, size_t thread) override
functions.description: Backpropagates through the fully connected layer: computes prevDelta = W^T * currDelta, applies previous activation derivative, and accumulates dWeight (outer products) and dBias.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber(true).
currDelta.size() must equal _dst.width.
Previous layer’s forward output must be available to compute activation derivative and dWeight accumulation.
dWeight size must be _src.width * _dst.width; if bias is present, dBias size must be _dst.width.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FanSrc
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FanSrc() const override
functions.description: Returns the fan-in for this fully connected layer: _src.width (input length).
requirements: Callable after construction.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FanDst
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::FullyConnectedLayer::FanDst() const override
functions.description: Returns the fan-out for this fully connected layer: _dst.width (output length).
requirements: Callable after construction.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::DropoutLayer
functions.signature: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::DropoutLayer(size_t srcSize, float rate)
functions.description: Constructs a dropout layer (inverted dropout) with given vector length and retention probability rate. During training, a random mask with probability rate of 1s is applied and outputs are scaled by 1/rate.
requirements: srcSize > 0.
rate must be in (0, 1]; scale is 1/rate.
SetThreadNumber(train=true) is required before training to allocate mask storage.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::Forward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::Forward(const Vector & src, size_t thread, Method method) override
functions.description: Applies dropout mask during training (method==Train): dst[i] = mask[i] * (1/rate) * src[i]. In inference modes, forwards input unchanged. Mask selection uses a pre-generated random buffer.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber().
src.size() must equal _src.Volume().
When method==Train, _mask must be initialized (via SetThreadNumber(train=true)); random mask pointer is chosen per call.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::Backward
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::Backward(const Vector & currDelta, size_t thread) override
functions.description: Backpropagates through dropout by multiplying incoming delta by the same binary mask used in the corresponding forward pass, then applies the previous layer’s activation derivative.
requirements: thread must be valid as per SetThreadNumber(true).
currDelta.size() must equal _dst.Volume().
The same mask used in Forward for the same thread must still be referenced in _specific[thread].mask.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::FanSrc
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::FanSrc() const override
functions.description: Returns 1; dropout does not change connectivity in the sense used for weight initialization.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::FanDst
functions.signature: virtual size_t Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::FanDst() const override
functions.description: Returns 1; dropout does not change connectivity in the sense used for weight initialization.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::SetThreadNumber
functions.signature: virtual void Simd::Neural::DropoutLayer::SetThreadNumber(size_t number, bool train) override
functions.description: Allocates per-thread storage and, when train==true, generates a large random mask buffer used to supply contiguous masks for forward passes.
requirements: number must be >= 1.
When train==true, allocates _mask of size _src.Volume()*(1+RandomSize()); fills with Bernoulli(rate).

functions.signature: Simd::Neural::Network::Network()

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Network::Train
functions.signature: template <class Logger> bool Simd::Neural::Network::Train(const Vectors & src, const Labels & dst, const TrainOptions & options, Logger logger)
functions.description: Trains the network using vector inputs and class labels. Converts labels to target vectors using the output layer’s activation min/max, then delegates to the vector-vector Train overload.

functions.signature: void Simd::Neural::Network::SetThreadNumber(size_t number, bool train = false)
functions.description: Sets per-layer thread counts by calling SetThreadNumber(number, train) on each layer. Use when calling Predict from multiple threads or preparing training buffers.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Network::Predict
functions.signature: const Vector & Simd::Neural::Network::Predict(const Vector & x, size_t thread = 0, Layer::Method method = Layer::Fast)
functions.description: Runs a forward pass through all layers for the given input vector using the specified method and returns a reference to the per-thread output vector.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Network::Load
functions.signature: bool Simd::Neural::Network::Load(const void * data, size_t size, bool train = false)
functions.description: Loads network weights (and optionally training accumulators) from a contiguous memory buffer. If train==true, prepares layers for training and also loads gradient accumulators.
requirements: data must point to a buffer of at least Requred(train) bytes; function returns false if size is insufficient.
If train==true, layers’ SetThreadNumber(1, true) is invoked to size temporary buffers before loading gWeight/gBias.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Network::Save
functions.signature: bool Simd::Neural::Network::Save(void * data, size_t * size, bool train = false) const
functions.description: Serializes network weights (and optionally training accumulators) into a contiguous memory buffer. If the provided buffer is too small, writes the required size to *size and returns false.
requirements: size must point to a valid size_t; on input, *size is the buffer capacity in bytes; on output, it is set to the required size.
If data is non-null and *size is sufficient, data must be writable for Requred(train) bytes.

functions.name: Simd::Neural::Network::Convert
functions.signature: void Simd::Neural::Network::Convert(const Labels & src, Vectors & dst) const
functions.description: Converts class labels into target vectors sized to the network’s output volume. Fills each vector with activation-specific min and sets the label index to activation-specific max.
requirements: Network must have at least one layer; uses the last layer’s output size and activation function min/max.
Each label value less than output size is set to max; others leave the vector as min-only.

functions.name: Simd::Detection::LoadStringXml
functions.signature: bool LoadStringXml(const std::string & xml, Tag tag = UNDEFINED_OBJECT_TAG)
functions.description: Loads a classifier cascade from an XML string into this detector instance. Supports OpenCV-style HAAR and LBP cascades (non-tree, modern format). Can be called multiple times to add multiple cascades; each loaded cascade is tagged with the provided user-defined tag for later identification in detection results. Returns true if the cascade was successfully parsed and initialized, false otherwise.
requirements: xml must contain a valid OpenCV HAAR or LBP cascade in a supported (non-tree, non-legacy) XML format.
May be called multiple times before Init to add several cascades; each call appends another detector.
If loading succeeds, the cascade window size and flags are queried and stored; otherwise, no state is added and the function returns false.
tag is a user-defined integer label associated with detections produced by this cascade (optional).

functions.name: Simd::Detection::Load
functions.signature: bool Load(const std::string & path, Tag tag = UNDEFINED_OBJECT_TAG)
functions.description: Loads a classifier cascade from a file path into this detector instance. Supports OpenCV-style HAAR and LBP cascades (non-tree, modern format). Can be called multiple times to use several detectors concurrently; detections will carry the provided tag. Returns true on success, false if the file cannot be loaded or is unsupported.
requirements: path must point to a readable file containing a supported OpenCV HAAR or LBP cascade (non-tree, non-legacy format).
May be called multiple times before Init to add several cascades; each successful call appends another detector.
If loading succeeds, the cascade window size and flags are queried and stored; otherwise, no state is added and the function returns false.
tag is a user-defined integer label associated with detections produced by this cascade (optional).

functions.name: Simd::Detection::Init
functions.signature: bool Init(const Size & imageSize, double scaleFactor = 1.1, const Size & sizeMin = Size(0, 0), const Size & sizeMax = Size(INT_MAX, INT_MAX), const View & roi = View(), ptrdiff_t threadNumber = -1)
functions.description: Prepares the detector for processing images of the given size by building scaled levels and initializing internal cascade instances for each level. Allows specifying the image pyramid scale factor, minimum/maximum object sizes to search for, an optional ROI mask, and a thread count. Returns true if at least one level is initialized; false if no cascades have been loaded or setup failed.
requirements: At least one cascade must have been successfully loaded via Load or LoadStringXml prior to calling Init; otherwise it returns false.
imageSize must match the size of images that will be passed later to Detect; Detect will return false if sizes differ.
scaleFactor should be greater than 1.0 to ensure a finite number of pyramid levels (inferred from the multiplicative loop).

sizeMin and sizeMax define allowable detection window sizes; detections are considered only for scales where the cascade window size scaled by the level is within [sizeMin, sizeMax] and does not exceed imageSize (inferred from window checks).
roi, if provided, is treated as an 8-bit mask (non-zero = allowed area). If empty (format == View::None), the full image is used. The ROI is resized internally per level and binarized.

threadNumber: use -1 to auto-select hardware_concurrency(); otherwise values <=0 default to auto; values above hardware_concurrency() are clamped to hardware_concurrency() (inferred from implementation).

functions.name: Simd::Detection::Detect
functions.signature: bool Detect(const View & src, Objects & objects, int groupSizeMin = 3, double sizeDifferenceMax = 0.2, bool motionMask = false, const Rects & motionRegions = Rects())
functions.description: Runs object detection on the given image using the previously initialized cascades and image pyramid. Produces a list of detected objects, optionally grouping elementary detections based on proximity/size similarity. Optionally restricts search using a motion mask derived from provided regions in addition to the ROI set at Init. Returns true on success; returns false if not initialized or if the source image size does not match the size specified to Init.
requirements: Init must have been successfully called after loading cascades and before calling Detect.
src.Size() must exactly match the imageSize passed to Init; otherwise Detect returns false.
src can be grayscale or color; it will be converted to 8-bit grayscale internally if needed (inferred from FillLevels).
objects is cleared and then populated on success; if no detections meet grouping criteria, it may remain empty.
groupSizeMin controls minimum votes per group; if set to 0, grouping suppresses output (no groups are emitted) even though per-level detection still runs (inferred from GroupObjects behavior).
sizeDifferenceMax is a non-negative similarity threshold used in grouping; typical values are in [0,1] (inferred from usage in grouping heuristics).
If motionMask is true, only areas within the union of motionRegions (mapped to each pyramid level) and the ROI are searched; motionRegions are expected in source-image coordinates and may be empty.
Threading: detection work is parallelized internally up to the thread count configured in Init; callers need not create threads around this call (informational, inferred).

functions.name: Simd::Xml::ParseError::What

functions.name: Simd::Xml::Document::Parse
functions.signature: template<int Flags, class Ch> void Simd::Xml::Document<Ch>::Parse(Ch * text)
functions.description: Parses the XML document from a modifiable character buffer ‘text’ into this Document. Behavior is controlled by template bitmask Flags (e.g., ParseFull, ParseNonDestructive, etc.).
requirements: Assertion: text must be non-null.
Unless Flags includes ParseNoStringTerminators, the parser writes NUL terminators into the buffer; therefore text must be writable and persist for the parse duration.
On parse errors, throws Simd::Xml::ParseError (use What() and Where() to inspect).
This clears existing nodes/attributes in the document before parsing.

Safe to call multiple times.

Typical usage: pass std::cout or any std::ostream to receive a one-line summary including Simd version, CPU model, sockets/cores/threads, cache sizes, RAM, and available SIMD instruction sets.
requirements: os must be a valid output stream; the function writes to it.

functions.name: Simd::AbsDifference
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AbsDifference(const View<A>& a, const View<A>& b, View<A>& c)
functions.description: Computes the absolute difference of two 8-bit grayscale images, pixel by pixel, writing results to c. Wraps ::SimdAbsDifference.
requirements: a, b, and c must be Compatible (same width, height, stride semantics) and format Gray8.
a and b must have identical dimensions; c must match a/b dimensions.

functions.name: Simd::AbsDifferenceSum
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AbsDifferenceSum(const View<A>& a, const View<A>& b, uint64_t & sum)
functions.description: Computes the sum of absolute differences (SAD) between two 8-bit grayscale images. Wraps ::SimdAbsDifferenceSum.
requirements: a and b must be Compatible (same width and height) and format Gray8.
sum must be a valid reference to receive the result.

functions.name: Simd::AbsDifferenceSums3x3
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AbsDifferenceSums3x3(const View<A>& current, const View<A>& background, uint64_t * sums)
functions.description: Computes nine sums of absolute differences between two 8-bit grayscale images over a 3x3 neighborhood of relative shifts ([-1,1] in x and y). Uses central part of current (indent 1) and corresponding shifted regions of background. Wraps ::SimdAbsDifferenceSums3x3.
requirements: current and background must be Compatible and Gray8.
current.width > 2 and current.height > 2.
sums must point to a buffer of at least 9 uint64_t entries.

functions.name: Simd::AbsGradientSaturatedSum
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AbsGradientSaturatedSum(const View<A>& src, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Computes saturated sum of absolute gradients (|dx|+|dy| clipped to 255) for an 8-bit grayscale image; border pixels set to 0. Wraps ::SimdAbsGradientSaturatedSum.
requirements: src and dst must be Compatible and Gray8.
src.width >= 3 and src.height >= 3.

functions.name: Simd::AddFeatureDifference
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AddFeatureDifference(const View<A>& value, const View<A>& lo, const View<A>& hi, uint16_t weight, View<A>& difference)
functions.description: Adds a weighted squared excess beyond [lo, hi] per pixel to an accumulating difference image used in motion detection. For each i: excess = max(lo[i]-value[i],0)+max(value[i]-hi[i],0); difference[i] += (weight*excess*excess)>>16. Wraps ::SimdAddFeatureDifference.
requirements: value, lo, hi, and difference must be Compatible and Gray8.
weight is a 16-bit unsigned factor.

functions.name: Simd::AlphaBlending
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AlphaBlending(const View<A>& src, const View<A>& alpha, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Performs per-pixel alpha blending: dst = (src*alpha + dst*(255-alpha))/255. Supports 8-bit-per-channel formats; alpha is Gray8. Wraps ::SimdAlphaBlending.
requirements: src and dst must be Compatible; alpha must be EqualSize to dst.
alpha must be Gray8.
src.ChannelSize() must be 1 (8 bits per channel).

functions.name: Simd::AlphaBlending2x
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AlphaBlending2x(const View<A>& src0, const View<A>& alpha0, const View<A>& src1, const View<A>& alpha1, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Performs two sequential alpha blends onto dst: tmp = blend(src0, alpha0, dst); dst = blend(src1, alpha1, tmp). Supports 8-bit-per-channel formats. Wraps ::SimdAlphaBlending2x.
requirements: src0, src1, and dst must be Compatible; alpha0 and alpha1 must be Compatible with each other and EqualSize to dst.
alpha images must be Gray8.
dst.ChannelSize() must be 1 (8 bits per channel).

functions.name: Simd::AlphaBlendingBgraToYuv420p
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AlphaBlendingBgraToYuv420p(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& y, View<A>& u, View<A>& v, SimdYuvType yuvType = SimdYuvBt601)
functions.description: Alpha blends a BGRA image over an existing YUV420P image (Y, U, V planes), producing updated YUV420P. Wraps ::SimdAlphaBlendingBgraToYuv420p.
requirements: bgra must be Bgra32; y,u,v must be Gray8.
y must have same width/height as bgra.
u and v must each be half resolution of y in both dimensions and same format as y.

functions.name: Simd::AlphaFilling
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A, class Pixel> void AlphaFilling(View<A>& dst, const Pixel& pixel, const View<A>& alpha)
functions.description: Fills dst by blending a constant pixel color through an alpha mask: dst = (pixel*alpha + dst*(255-alpha))/255. Wraps ::SimdAlphaFilling.
requirements: dst and alpha must be EqualSize; alpha must be Gray8.
dst.ChannelSize() must be 1 (8 bits per channel).
dst.ChannelCount() must equal sizeof(Pixel).
Pixel must be a POD color matching dst format size (1..4 bytes).

functions.name: Simd::AlphaPremultiply
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AlphaPremultiply(const View<A>& src, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Creates a premultiplied-alpha image from BGRA/RGBA/ARGB: color channels multiplied by alpha; alpha unchanged. Wraps ::SimdAlphaPremultiply.
requirements: src and dst must be Compatible.
src.format must be one of Bgra32, Rgba32, or Argb32.

functions.name: Simd::AlphaUnpremultiply
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void AlphaUnpremultiply(const View<A>& src, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Converts a premultiplied-alpha BGRA/RGBA/ARGB image to straight alpha by dividing color channels by alpha; alpha unchanged. Wraps ::SimdAlphaUnpremultiply.
requirements: src and dst must be Compatible.
src.format must be one of Bgra32, Rgba32, or Argb32.
Division by zero behavior follows underlying implementation; ensure meaningful alpha values.

requirements: value, lo, and hi must be Compatible and Gray8.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToBayer
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToBayer(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& bayer)

functions.name: Simd::BgraToBgr

functions.description: Converts 32-bit BGRA to 24-bit BGR, dropping alpha. Wraps ::SimdBgraToBgr.
requirements: bgra and bgr must be EqualSize; bgra format Bgra32; bgr format Bgr24.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToGray
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToGray(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& gray)
functions.description: Converts 32-bit BGRA to 8-bit grayscale. Wraps ::SimdBgraToGray.
requirements: bgra and gray must be EqualSize; bgra format Bgra32; gray format Gray8.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToRgb
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToRgb(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& rgb)
functions.description: Converts 32-bit BGRA to 24-bit RGB. Wraps ::SimdBgraToRgb.
requirements: bgra and rgb must be EqualSize; bgra format Bgra32; rgb format Rgb24.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToRgba
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToRgba(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& rgba)
functions.description: Reorders channels from BGRA to RGBA. Wraps ::SimdBgraToRgba.
requirements: bgra and rgba must be EqualSize; bgra Bgra32; rgba Rgba32.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToYuv420p
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToYuv420p(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& y, View<A>& u, View<A>& v, SimdYuvType yuvType = SimdYuvBt601)
functions.description: Converts BGRA to planar YUV420P. Wraps ::SimdBgraToYuv420pV2.
requirements: bgra must be Bgra32.
y must be Gray8 and same size as bgra.
u and v must be Gray8 and be half width/height of y and same format as y.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToYuv422p
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToYuv422p(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& y, View<A>& u, View<A>& v, SimdYuvType yuvType = SimdYuvBt601)
functions.description: Converts BGRA to planar YUV422P. Wraps ::SimdBgraToYuv422pV2.
requirements: bgra must be Bgra32.
y must be Gray8 and same size as bgra.
u and v must be Gray8 with half width (same height) of y and same format as y.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToYuv444p
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToYuv444p(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& y, View<A>& u, View<A>& v, SimdYuvType yuvType = SimdYuvBt601)
functions.description: Converts BGRA to planar YUV444P (full resolution U and V). Wraps ::SimdBgraToYuv444pV2.
requirements: bgra must be Bgra32.
y,u,v must be Gray8, Compatible with each other, and EqualSize to bgra.

functions.name: Simd::BgraToYuva420p
functions.signature: template <template<class> class A> void BgraToYuva420p(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& y, View<A>& u, View<A>& v, View<A>& a, SimdYuvType yuvType = SimdYuvBt601)
functions.description: Converts BGRA to planar YUVA420P (including separate A plane). Wraps ::SimdBgraToYuva420pV2.
requirements: bgra must be Bgra32.
y and a must be Gray8 and EqualSize to bgra.
u and v must be Gray8 and half width/height of y; u and v must be Compatible.

functions.description: Converts 24-bit BGR to planar YUV422P. Wraps ::SimdBgrToYuv422pV2.

functions.name: Simd::Binarization
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void Binarization(const View<A>& src, uint8_t value, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, View<A>& dst, SimdCompareType compareType)
functions.description: Binarizes a Gray8 image using a scalar threshold and comparison type; writes positive or negative value per pixel. Wrapper over ::SimdBinarization.
requirements: src and dst must be the same size and compatible strides/layouts
src.format == View<A>::Gray8
dst.format == View<A>::Gray8
compareType must be a valid SimdCompareType

functions.name: Simd::AveragingBinarization
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void AveragingBinarization(const View<A>& src, uint8_t value, size_t neighborhood, uint8_t threshold, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, View<A>& dst, SimdCompareType compareType)
functions.description: Neighborhood-based binarization counting how many neighbors satisfy compare(src, value) and comparing to threshold. Wrapper over ::SimdAveragingBinarization.
requirements: src and dst must be same size
src.format == View<A>::Gray8
dst.format == View<A>::Gray8
neighborhood defines a square window radius (non-negative)
threshold in [0,255]
compareType valid SimdCompareType

functions.name: Simd::AveragingBinarizationV2
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void AveragingBinarizationV2(const View<A>& src, size_t neighborhood, int32_t shift, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Averaging binarization comparing (src[x,y] + shift)*area > neighborhood sum over window. Wrapper over ::SimdAveragingBinarizationV2.
requirements: src and dst same size
src.format == View<A>::Gray8
dst.format == View<A>::Gray8
shift must be in [-255, 255] as per docs; int32 accepted
neighborhood is window radius (non-negative)

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalCount8u

functions.description: Counts pixels in Gray8 image satisfying compare(src[i], value). Wrapper over ::SimdConditionalCount8u.
requirements: src.format == View<A>::Gray8
count is output reference
compareType valid

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalCount16i
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void ConditionalCount16i(const View<A> & src, int16_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint32_t & count)
functions.description: Counts pixels in Int16 image satisfying compare(src[i], value). Wrapper over ::SimdConditionalCount16i.
requirements: src.format == View<A>::Int16
count is output reference
compareType valid

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalSum

functions.description: Sums src pixels where Gray8 mask satisfies compare(mask[i], value). Wrapper over ::SimdConditionalSum.
requirements: src and mask same size

mask.format == View<A>::Gray8
sum is output reference
compareType valid

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalSquareSum
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void ConditionalSquareSum(const View<A>& src, const View<A>& mask, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint64_t & sum)

requirements: src and mask same size
src.format == View<A>::Gray8
mask.format == View<A>::Gray8
sum is output reference
compareType valid

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalSquareGradientSum
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void ConditionalSquareGradientSum(const View<A>& src, const View<A>& mask, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint64_t & sum)

requirements: src and mask same size

src.width >= 3 and src.height >= 3
sum is output reference

functions.name: Simd::ConditionalFill

requirements: src and dst same size
src.format == View<A>::Gray8
dst.format == View<A>::Gray8
compareType valid

functions.name: Simd::Copy

functions.description: Copies image pixels from src to dst. Wrapper over ::SimdCopy.
requirements: src and dst must be compatible (same size, format, stride expectations)

dst must have sufficient storage

functions.name: Simd::Copy
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void Copy(const Pyramid<A> & src, Pyramid<A> & dst)
functions.description: Copies each level from one image pyramid to another.
requirements: src.Size() == dst.Size()
Each corresponding level images must be allocated and same size/format

functions.name: Simd::CopyFrame
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void CopyFrame(const View<A>& src, const Rectangle<ptrdiff_t> & frame, View<A>& dst)
functions.description: Copies src into dst except the rectangular frame region (frame bounds not copied). Wrapper over ::SimdCopyFrame.
requirements: src and dst compatible (same size/format)
frame.Width() >= 0 and frame.Height() >= 0
0 <= frame.left/top and frame.right <= src.width and frame.bottom <= src.height

functions.name: Simd::DeinterleaveUv

If v is not empty: EqualSize(uv,v) and v.format == View<A>::Gray8

functions.name: Simd::DeinterleaveBgr

functions.name: Simd::DeinterleaveBgra
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void DeinterleaveBgra(const View<A>& bgra, View<A>& b, View<A>& g, View<A>& r, View<A>& a)
functions.description: Splits BGRA interleaved image into separate Gray8 B,G,R,A planes. Wrapper over ::SimdDeinterleaveBgra.
requirements: bgra.format == View<A>::Bgr32 (BGRA32)
If any of b,g,r,a are not empty: EqualSize(bgra, plane) and plane.format == View<A>::Gray8

functions.name: Simd::DeinterleaveRgb
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void DeinterleaveRgb(const View<A>& rgb, View<A>& r, View<A>& g, View<A>& b)
functions.description: Splits RGB interleaved image into separate Gray8 R,G,B planes. Wrapper uses ::SimdDeinterleaveBgr.
requirements: rgb.format == View<A>::Rgb24
If any of r,g,b are not empty: EqualSize(rgb, plane) and plane.format == View<A>::Gray8

functions.name: Simd::DeinterleaveRgba
functions.signature: template<template<class> class A> SIMD_INLINE void DeinterleaveRgba(const View<A>& rgba, View<A>& r, View<A>& g, View<A>& b, View<A>& a)
functions.description: Splits RGBA interleaved image into separate Gray8 R,G,B,A planes. Wrapper uses ::SimdDeinterleaveBgra.
requirements: rgba.format == View<A>::Rgba32
