Strides must accommodate image widths.

functions.name: SimdAlphaBlending2x
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaBlending2x(const uint8_t* src0, size_t src0Stride, const uint8_t* alpha0, size_t alpha0Stride, const uint8_t* src1, size_t src1Stride, const uint8_t* alpha1, size_t alpha1Stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Performs two sequential alpha blends over dst: first blend src0 with alpha0 into dst, then blend src1 with alpha1 over the result.
requirements: All images must share the same width, height, and channelCount (1..4 channels, 8-bit per channel).
alpha0 and alpha1 are 8-bit gray images with same dimensions.
Strides must be valid for the given widths.

functions.name: SimdAlphaBlendingBgraToYuv420p
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaBlendingBgraToYuv420p(const uint8_t* bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Alpha blends a BGRA image onto an existing YUV420P image in-place (Y,U,V planes updated) using the BGRA alpha channel and specified YUV standard.
requirements: width and height must be even.
BGRA and Y planes have the same width and height; U and V have half width and half height.
y, u, v buffers must be pre-initialized background that will be blended into.
yuvType must be a valid SimdYuvType.

functions.name: SimdAlphaBlendingUniform
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaBlendingUniform(const uint8_t* src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t alpha, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Blends src over dst with a uniform 8-bit alpha: dst = (src*alpha + dst*(255-alpha))/255. Supports 1..4 channels.
requirements: src and dst: same size and channelCount (1..4), 8-bit per channel.
alpha is a scalar 0..255.
Strides must be valid.

functions.name: SimdAlphaFilling
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaFilling(uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * channel, size_t channelCount, const uint8_t * alpha, size_t alphaStride)
functions.description: Alpha-fills dst with a constant pixel color (channel[0..channelCount-1]) blended over existing dst using an 8-bit alpha image.
requirements: dst is 8-bit image with channelCount in [1..4].
channel must point to at least channelCount bytes defining the fill color.
alpha must be 8-bit gray of same width and height as dst.

functions.name: SimdAlphaPremultiply
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaPremultiply(const uint8_t* src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride, SimdBool argb)
functions.description: Converts an image with alpha (BGRA/RGBA/ARGB) to premultiplied-alpha form: color channels multiplied by alpha, alpha unchanged.
requirements: src and dst must be same size and one of BGRA32, RGBA32, or ARGB32 (8-bit per channel).
argb indicates channel order: SimdFalse for BGRA32/RGBA32; SimdTrue for ARGB32.

functions.name: SimdAlphaUnpremultiply
functions.signature: void SimdAlphaUnpremultiply(const uint8_t* src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride, SimdBool argb)
functions.description: Converts from premultiplied alpha image back to straight alpha by dividing color channels by alpha (leaves alpha unchanged).
requirements: src and dst must be same size and one of BGRA32, RGBA32, or ARGB32 (8-bit per channel).
argb indicates channel order: SimdFalse for BGRA32/RGBA32; SimdTrue for ARGB32.
Division by zero if alpha == 0 is implied by algorithm; library handles it (behavior unspecified in doc).

functions.name: SimdBackgroundGrowRangeSlow
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundGrowRangeSlow(const uint8_t * value, size_t valueStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * lo, size_t loStride, uint8_t * hi, size_t hiStride)
functions.description: Slow-mode background range update for motion detection: slowly expands [lo,hi] envelopes towards current value by 1 when exceeded.
requirements: value, lo, hi are 8-bit gray images with same width and height.
Updates lo and hi in place per formula.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundGrowRangeFast
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundGrowRangeFast(const uint8_t * value, size_t valueStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * lo, size_t loStride, uint8_t * hi, size_t hiStride)
functions.description: Fast-mode background range update: sets lo=min(lo,value) and hi=max(hi,value) per pixel.
requirements: value, lo, hi are 8-bit gray images with same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundIncrementCount
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundIncrementCount(const uint8_t * value, size_t valueStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * loValue, size_t loValueStride, const uint8_t * hiValue, size_t hiValueStride, uint8_t * loCount, size_t loCountStride, uint8_t * hiCount, size_t hiCountStride)
functions.description: Updates counters loCount and hiCount depending on whether current value is below loValue or above hiValue, saturating at 255.
requirements: All images (value, loValue, hiValue, loCount, hiCount) are 8-bit gray, same width and height.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundAdjustRange
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundAdjustRange(uint8_t * loCount, size_t loCountStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * loValue, size_t loValueStride, uint8_t * hiCount, size_t hiCountStride, uint8_t * hiValue, size_t hiValueStride, uint8_t threshold)
functions.description: Adjusts background range bounds per counters: decreases/increases loValue and hiValue depending on counts vs threshold; resets counts to 0.
requirements: loCount, loValue, hiCount, hiValue are 8-bit gray images with same width and height.
threshold is an 8-bit value.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundAdjustRangeMasked
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundAdjustRangeMasked(uint8_t * loCount, size_t loCountStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * loValue, size_t loValueStride, uint8_t * hiCount, size_t hiCountStride, uint8_t * hiValue, size_t hiValueStride, uint8_t threshold, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride)
functions.description: Like SimdBackgroundAdjustRange but only applies adjustments where mask is non-zero.
requirements: loCount, loValue, hiCount, hiValue, and mask are 8-bit gray, same size.
threshold is 8-bit.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundShiftRange
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundShiftRange(const uint8_t * value, size_t valueStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * lo, size_t loStride, uint8_t * hi, size_t hiStride)
functions.description: Shifts the background [lo,hi] range towards current value when value is outside the range, clamping to [0,255].
requirements: value, lo, hi are 8-bit gray images with same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundShiftRangeMasked
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundShiftRangeMasked(const uint8_t * value, size_t valueStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * lo, size_t loStride, uint8_t * hi, size_t hiStride, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride)
functions.description: Like SimdBackgroundShiftRange, but applies updates only where mask is non-zero.
requirements: value, lo, hi, mask are 8-bit gray images with same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdBackgroundInitMask
functions.signature: void SimdBackgroundInitMask(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t index, uint8_t value, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Creates a mask image by setting dst[i]=value where src[i]==index, otherwise leaves as-is/zero per usual semantics (doc shows only assignment when equal).
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray images of the same size.
index and value are 8-bit scalars.

functions.name: SimdBase64Decode
functions.signature: void SimdBase64Decode(const uint8_t* src, size_t srcSize, uint8_t* dst, size_t* dstSize)
functions.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded byte sequence into raw bytes.
requirements: dst buffer must be large enough: at least srcSize/4*3 bytes.
dstSize must be a valid pointer; it receives the decoded length.
src points to srcSize bytes of Base64 data (may include padding).

functions.name: SimdBase64Encode
functions.signature: void SimdBase64Encode(const uint8_t* src, size_t size, uint8_t* dst)
functions.description: Encodes raw bytes into Base64 ASCII output (unpadded/padded per library implementation).
requirements: dst buffer must be at least ((size + 2) / 3) * 4 bytes.
src points to size bytes.

functions.name: SimdBayerToBgr
functions.signature: void SimdBayerToBgr(const uint8_t * bayer, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bayerStride, SimdPixelFormatType bayerFormat, uint8_t * bgr, size_t bgrStride)
functions.description: Converts an 8-bit Bayer pattern image to 24-bit BGR.
requirements: width and height must be even.
bayerFormat must be one of SimdPixelFormatBayer{Grbg,Gbrg,Rggb,Bggr}.
bayer and bgr buffers must accommodate the image sizes.

functions.name: SimdBayerToBgra
functions.signature: void SimdBayerToBgra(const uint8_t * bayer, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bayerStride, SimdPixelFormatType bayerFormat, uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t alpha)
functions.description: Converts an 8-bit Bayer pattern image to 32-bit BGRA with constant alpha.
requirements: width and height must be even.
bayerFormat must be a valid Bayer format.
alpha is applied as the 4th channel.

functions.name: SimdBgraToBayer
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToBayer(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t * bayer, size_t bayerStride, SimdPixelFormatType bayerFormat)
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit BGRA image to an 8-bit Bayer pattern image.
requirements: width and height must be even.
bayerFormat selects the Bayer mosaic arrangement.
Input and output sizes must match.

functions.name: SimdBgraToBgr
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToBgr(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t * bgr, size_t bgrStride)
functions.description: Drops alpha channel converting 32-bit BGRA (or RGBA) to 24-bit BGR (or RGB).
requirements: Input and output images must have same dimensions.
Channel order conversion as documented: BGRA->BGR or RGBA->RGB.

functions.name: SimdBgraToGray
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToGray(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t * gray, size_t grayStride)
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit BGRA image to an 8-bit grayscale image.
requirements: Input and output dimensions must match.

functions.name: SimdBgraToRgb
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToRgb(const uint8_t* bgra, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t* rgb, size_t rgbStride)
functions.description: Converts 32-bit BGRA to 24-bit RGB (or RGBA to BGR).
requirements: Input and output images must have same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdBgraToRgba
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToRgba(const uint8_t* bgra, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t* rgba, size_t rgbaStride)
functions.description: Reorders channels from BGRA to RGBA (or vice versa when inputs are RGBA).
requirements: Input and output images must have same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdBgraToYuv420pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToYuv420pV2(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * y, size_t yStride, uint8_t * u, size_t uStride, uint8_t * v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit BGRA image to YUV420P planes (Y full resolution, U/V half resolution) using the given YUV standard.
requirements: width and height must be even.
BGRA and Y have same dimensions; U and V are half width/height.
yuvType must be valid (e.g., Bt601/Bt709/Bt2020/Trect871).

functions.name: SimdBgraToYuv422pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToYuv422pV2(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * y, size_t yStride, uint8_t * u, size_t uStride, uint8_t * v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit BGRA image to YUV422P planes using the specified YUV standard.
requirements: BGRA and Y have same dimensions; U and V are half width (same height).
width must be even.
yuvType must be valid.

functions.name: SimdBgraToYuv444pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToYuv444pV2(const uint8_t* bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit BGRA image to YUV444P planes (all full resolution) using the specified YUV standard.
requirements: All planes have same width and height as BGRA.
yuvType must be valid.

functions.name: SimdBgraToYuva420pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgraToYuva420pV2(const uint8_t* bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, uint8_t* a, size_t aStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts 32-bit BGRA to YUVA420P (Y/U/V/A planes), using specified YUV standard; U/V are half res, A plane is copied from alpha.
requirements: width and height must be even.
Y and A are full res; U and V are half width/height.
yuvType must be valid.

functions.name: SimdBgrToBayer
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToBayer(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * bayer, size_t bayerStride, SimdPixelFormatType bayerFormat)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to an 8-bit Bayer image (one of GRBG, GBRG, RGGB, BGGR). Use when you need to simulate or reconstruct a Bayer mosaic from interleaved BGR. The output has the same width/height as input and must be even in both dimensions.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
width and height must be even.
bgr points to a 24-bit BGR image; bgrStride is the row size in bytes.
bayer points to an 8-bit output Bayer image; bayerStride is the row size in bytes.
bayerFormat must be one of: SimdPixelFormatBayerGrbg, SimdPixelFormatBayerGbrg, SimdPixelFormatBayerRggb, SimdPixelFormatBayerBggr.
All pointers must be valid and non-overlapping or safely overlapping as required by caller.

functions.name: SimdBgrToBgra
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToBgra(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t alpha)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to a 32-bit BGRA image, filling the alpha channel with the supplied alpha value. Use to add a constant alpha channel.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr is 24-bit BGR; bgra is 32-bit BGRA.
Provide valid strides in bytes for each image.
alpha supplies the output A channel value in range [0..255].

functions.name: SimdBgr48pToBgra32
functions.signature: void SimdBgr48pToBgra32(const uint8_t * blue, size_t blueStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * green, size_t greenStride, const uint8_t * red, size_t redStride, uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t alpha)
functions.description: Converts a 48-bit planar BGR (three 16-bit planes: Blue, Green, Red) to 32-bit interleaved BGRA (8-bit per channel) with constant alpha. Used to downconvert 16-bit-per-channel planar images to 8-bit BGRA.
requirements: All images must have the same width and height.
blue/green/red point to 16-bit planar images; their strides are in bytes.
bgra points to 32-bit BGRA output; bgraStride is in bytes.
alpha is the output alpha value (0..255).

functions.name: SimdBgrToGray
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToGray(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * gray, size_t grayStride)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to an 8-bit grayscale image. Standard luma conversion is used (implementation-defined within the library).
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr is 24-bit BGR; gray is 8-bit.
Provide valid strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdBgrToHsl
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToHsl(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * hsl, size_t hslStride)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to a 24-bit HSL image (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) with 8-bit channels. Use for color-space analysis in HSL.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr is 24-bit; hsl is 24-bit.
Provide valid strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdBgrToHsv
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToHsv(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * hsv, size_t hsvStride)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to a 24-bit HSV image (Hue, Saturation, Value) with 8-bit channels.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr is 24-bit; hsv is 24-bit.
Provide valid strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdBgrToLab
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToLab(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t bgrStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * lab, size_t labStride)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to a 24-bit CIELAB (L*a*b*) image with 8-bit channels. Useful for perceptual color operations.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr is 24-bit; lab is 24-bit.
Provide valid strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdBgrToRgb
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToRgb(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t width, size_t height, size_t bgrStride, uint8_t * rgb, size_t rgbStride)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to a 24-bit RGB image (channel swap). Can also be used inversely for RGB to BGR.
requirements: Input and output images must have the same width and height.
bgr and rgb are 24-bit images.
Provide valid strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdBgrToYuv420pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToYuv420pV2(const uint8_t* bgr, size_t bgrStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to planar YUV420P (subsampled U and V by 2 in both axes). Use for video encoding/IO.
requirements: BGR input and Y (luma) output must have identical width and height.
U and V outputs must be half width and half height of Y (i.e., width and height must be even).
width and height should be even to satisfy chroma subsampling.
yuvType selects the YUV standard (BT.601/709/2020 or Trect871 full range).
Provide valid strides for each plane.

functions.name: SimdBgrToYuv422pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToYuv422pV2(const uint8_t* bgr, size_t bgrStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to planar YUV422P (U and V width are half of Y).
requirements: BGR input and Y output must have identical width and height.
U and V have same height as Y, width is half of Y (width must be even).
yuvType chooses YUV standard; provide valid strides.

functions.name: SimdBgrToYuv444pV2
functions.signature: void SimdBgrToYuv444pV2(const uint8_t* bgr, size_t bgrStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, SimdYuvType yuvType)
functions.description: Converts a 24-bit BGR image to planar YUV444P (no subsampling).
requirements: BGR input and Y, U, V outputs must have the same width and height.
Provide valid strides for each plane.
yuvType selects matrix/range.

functions.name: SimdBinarization
functions.signature: void SimdBinarization(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t value, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride, SimdCompareType compareType)
functions.description: Performs threshold-like binarization on an 8-bit grayscale image using a specified comparison operator. Each pixel is set to 'positive' if compare(src[i], value) holds, otherwise 'negative'.
requirements: src and dst must be 8-bit gray and have the same width and height.
compareType defines comparison: Equal/NotEqual/Greater/... per SimdCompareType.
Provide valid strides in bytes.
positive and negative are output values in [0..255].

functions.name: SimdAveragingBinarization
functions.signature: void SimdAveragingBinarization(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t value, size_t neighborhood, uint8_t threshold, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride, SimdCompareType compareType)
functions.description: Averaging binarization of an 8-bit grayscale image: within a square neighborhood around each pixel, counts how many pixels satisfy compare(p, value) and compares that count against 'threshold' proportion (scaled by 255). Outputs positive/negative accordingly.
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray; same size.
neighborhood defines radius of window; window is (2*neighborhood+1)^2 intersected with image bounds.
threshold is in [0..255]; compareType per SimdCompareType.
Valid strides required.

functions.name: SimdAveragingBinarizationV2
functions.signature: void SimdAveragingBinarizationV2(const uint8_t* src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t neighborhood, int32_t shift, uint8_t positive, uint8_t negative, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Averaging binarization variant: compares (src[x,y] + shift) * area with sum of neighbor intensities over a window of radius 'neighborhood'. Outputs positive if greater, else negative.
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray; same size.
neighborhood defines window radius (non-negative).
shift in range [-255..255] per docs.
Provide valid strides.

functions.name: SimdConditionalCount8u
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalCount8u(const uint8_t * src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint32_t * count)
functions.description: Counts the number of pixels in an 8-bit grayscale image that satisfy compare(src[i], value).
requirements: src is 8-bit gray; width/height define image.
compareType per SimdCompareType.
count must point to valid uint32_t to receive result.
Valid stride in bytes.

functions.name: SimdConditionalCount16i
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalCount16i(const uint8_t * src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, int16_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint32_t * count)
functions.description: Counts the number of pixels in a 16-bit signed integer image that satisfy compare(src[i], value). Note: src points to pixel data but is declared uint8_t*; it addresses 16-bit samples as an image with pixel format Int16.
requirements: Image must have SimdPixelFormatInt16 (signed 16-bit per pixel).
stride is in bytes; width/height in pixels.
compareType per SimdCompareType.
count must be valid pointer to store result.

functions.name: SimdConditionalSum
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalSum(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint64_t * sum)
functions.description: Sums pixel values of src where the corresponding 8-bit mask pixel satisfies compare(mask[i], value).
requirements: src and mask are 8-bit gray; same width and height.
compareType per SimdCompareType.
sum must point to a valid uint64_t.
Provide strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdConditionalSquareSum
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalSquareSum(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint64_t * sum)
functions.description: Sums squared pixel values of src for pixels where mask satisfies compare(mask[i], value).
requirements: src and mask are 8-bit gray; same size.
compareType per SimdCompareType.
sum must be valid pointer to uint64_t.
Valid strides required.

functions.name: SimdConditionalSquareGradientSum
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalSquareGradientSum(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint64_t * sum)
functions.description: Sums squared gradient magnitude (dx^2+dy^2) at each non-border pixel where mask condition holds. dx and dy computed via central differences.
requirements: src and mask are 8-bit gray; same size.
width and height must be >= 3 (non-border condition).
compareType per SimdCompareType.
sum must be a valid uint64_t*.
Provide valid strides.

functions.name: SimdConditionalFill
functions.signature: void SimdConditionalFill(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t threshold, SimdCompareType compareType, uint8_t value, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Writes 'value' into dst for pixels whose src satisfies compare(src[i], threshold); leaves other dst pixels unchanged (or sets as per implementation writing only where condition is true). Used to mask-fill based on condition.
requirements: src and dst same width/height; 8-bit gray.
compareType per SimdCompareType.
Valid strides required.
value is 0..255.

functions.name: SimdCopy
functions.signature: void SimdCopy(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t pixelSize, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Copies rectangular pixel data from src image to dst image. Generic for different pixel sizes.
requirements: src and dst have same width, height, and pixel format/size.
pixelSize must reflect bytes per pixel (1..N).
Provide valid strides (bytes).
Memory regions must be valid; behavior with overlapping regions is unspecified (treat as memmove-safe not guaranteed).

functions.name: SimdCopyFrame
functions.signature: void SimdCopyFrame(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t pixelSize, size_t frameLeft, size_t frameTop, size_t frameRight, size_t frameBottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Copies an image except the rectangular frame area (left, top, right, bottom) which is excluded from copy. Useful for preserving a border or masking a region.
requirements: src and dst same size and pixel format.
pixelSize in bytes for the format.
Frame sides specify excluded rectangle; must be within image bounds and logically consistent (left<=right, top<=bottom).
Strides in bytes.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntInit
functions.signature: void * SimdDescrIntInit(size_t size, size_t depth)
functions.description: Initializes Integer Descriptor Engine to encode floating-point descriptors into a compact integer form. The context returned is used for encode/decode and distance computations.
requirements: size is the length of the original float descriptor; must be a multiple of 8 and <= 32768.
depth is the number of bits per encoded element; supported values: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
Returns NULL on error; must be released with SimdRelease().

functions.name: SimdDescrIntEncodedSize
functions.signature: size_t SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(const void* context)
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of the encoded integer descriptor for a given Integer Descriptor Engine context.
requirements: context must be a valid pointer returned by SimdDescrIntInit.
Undefined behavior if context is NULL.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntDecodedSize
functions.signature: size_t SimdDescrIntDecodedSize(const void* context)
functions.description: Returns the length (number of elements) of the original float descriptor the context is configured for.
requirements: context must be a valid pointer from SimdDescrIntInit.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntEncode32f
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntEncode32f(const void* context, const float * src, uint8_t * dst)
functions.description: Encodes a 32-bit float descriptor into the integer descriptor format defined by the context.
requirements: context must be created by SimdDescrIntInit and alive until call completes.
src length must equal SimdDescrIntDecodedSize(context).
dst buffer size in bytes must be at least SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).

functions.name: SimdDescrIntEncode16f
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntEncode16f(const void* context, const uint16_t * src, uint8_t * dst)
functions.description: Encodes a 16-bit float (half/bfloat16) descriptor into the integer descriptor format.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
src length equals SimdDescrIntDecodedSize(context).
dst capacity at least SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).

functions.name: SimdDescrIntDecode32f
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntDecode32f(const void* context, const uint8_t* src, float* dst)
functions.description: Decodes an integer descriptor back into 32-bit float form using the given context.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
src size in bytes equals SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).
dst length equals SimdDescrIntDecodedSize(context).

functions.name: SimdDescrIntDecode16f
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntDecode16f(const void* context, const uint8_t* src, uint16_t* dst)
functions.description: Decodes an integer descriptor back into 16-bit float form using the given context.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
src size in bytes equals SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).
dst length equals SimdDescrIntDecodedSize(context).

functions.name: SimdDescrIntCosineDistance
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntCosineDistance(const void* context, const uint8_t* a, const uint8_t* b, float* distance)
functions.description: Computes the cosine distance between two integer descriptors created by the descriptor engine.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
a and b must both be encoded descriptors of size SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).
distance must be a valid float* to receive the result.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntCosineDistancesMxNa
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntCosineDistancesMxNa(const void* context, size_t M, size_t N, const uint8_t* const* A, const uint8_t* const* B, float* distances)
functions.description: Computes pairwise cosine distances for two collections of descriptors: A with M members, B with N members. Outputs an M*N array of floats.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
A points to an array of M pointers to encoded descriptors; B to an array of N pointers.
Each descriptor must be of size SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).
distances buffer size must be at least M*N floats.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntCosineDistancesMxNp
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntCosineDistancesMxNp(const void* context, size_t M, size_t N, const uint8_t* A, const uint8_t* B, float* distances)
functions.description: Computes pairwise cosine distances for two flat arrays of encoded descriptors: A contains M descriptors, B contains N descriptors, each contiguous with size given by the context.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
A size must be at least M * SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context) bytes; B similarly for N.
distances must hold M*N floats.

functions.name: SimdDescrIntVectorNorm
functions.signature: void SimdDescrIntVectorNorm(const void* context, const uint8_t* a, float* norm)
functions.description: Computes the vector norm of a single encoded integer descriptor.
requirements: context valid from SimdDescrIntInit.
a must be an encoded descriptor of size SimdDescrIntEncodedSize(context).
norm must be a valid float pointer.

functions.name: SimdDeinterleaveUv
functions.signature: void SimdDeinterleaveUv(const uint8_t * uv, size_t uvStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * u, size_t uStride, uint8_t * v, size_t vStride)
functions.description: Splits an interleaved 16-bit UV plane (NV12/UV UV UV ...) into separate 8-bit U and V planar images. Use for NV12 -> YUV420P conversion.
requirements: All images must have the same width and height.
uv points to interleaved UV; uvStride is bytes per row.
u and/or v can be NULL to skip producing that plane; their strides still must be provided if non-NULL.

functions.name: SimdDeinterleaveBgr
functions.signature: void SimdDeinterleaveBgr(const uint8_t * bgr, size_t bgrStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * b, size_t bStride, uint8_t * g, size_t gStride, uint8_t * r, size_t rStride)
functions.description: Splits a 24-bit interleaved BGR image into three separate 8-bit planar channels (B, G, R). Any of b/g/r may be NULL to skip that plane.
requirements: Input and outputs must have same width/height.
bgr is 24-bit; b,g,r are 8-bit planes.
Provide valid strides; planes may be NULL to skip.

functions.name: SimdDeinterleaveBgra
functions.signature: void SimdDeinterleaveBgra(const uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * b, size_t bStride, uint8_t * g, size_t gStride, uint8_t * r, size_t rStride, uint8_t * a, size_t aStride)
functions.description: Splits a 32-bit interleaved BGRA image into four 8-bit planar channels (B, G, R, A). Any plane pointer may be NULL to skip.
requirements: Input and outputs must have same width and height.
bgra is 32-bit; b,g,r,a are 8-bit planes.
Provide valid strides; handle NULL planes appropriately.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLoadA
functions.signature: void * SimdDetectionLoadA(const char * path)
functions.description: Loads an OpenCV HAAR or LBP cascade classifier from an XML file on disk and returns an internal cascade handle for Simd detection API. Tree-based and old cascade formats are not supported.
requirements: path must point to a valid cascade file; returns NULL on error.
The returned pointer must be freed with SimdRelease().
Use the handle with SimdDetectionInfo and SimdDetectionInit.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLoadStringXml
functions.signature: void * SimdDetectionLoadStringXml(char * xml)
functions.description: Loads an OpenCV HAAR or LBP cascade classifier from an XML string buffer and returns an internal cascade handle. The buffer may be modified during load.
requirements: xml must point to a mutable C string with cascade XML.
Returns NULL on error; free with SimdRelease().
Use with SimdDetectionInfo / SimdDetectionInit.

functions.name: SimdDetectionInfo
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionInfo(const void * data, size_t * width, size_t * height, SimdDetectionInfoFlags * flags)
functions.description: Retrieves cascade window size and capability flags (e.g., tilted features, 16-bit support) for a loaded classifier.
requirements: data must be a valid cascade pointer from SimdDetectionLoadA/StringXml.
width, height, and flags must be valid pointers to receive results.

functions.name: SimdDetectionInit
functions.signature: void * SimdDetectionInit(const void * data, uint8_t * sum, size_t sumStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * sqsum, size_t sqsumStride, uint8_t * tilted, size_t tiltedStride, int throughColumn, int int16)
functions.description: Initializes an internal hidden detection structure for scanning a specific integral image size. Requires integral images (sum, optional sqsum, optional tilted). Returns a handle used for subsequent detection calls.
requirements: data must be a valid cascade from SimdDetectionLoadA/StringXml.
sum is 32-bit integral image (buffer typed as uint8_t*); its width/height must be input gray width+1 and height+1; sumStride in bytes.
sqsum is 32-bit integer or 64-bit float square integral image; can be NULL; same size as sum.
tilted is 32-bit integer tilted integral image; can be NULL; same size as sum.
width and height are the integral image dimensions (one more than original image).
throughColumn: non-zero may restrict detection to even positions for performance.
int16 flag selects 16-bit algorithm if supported (see SimdDetectionInfo).
Returns NULL on error; must be freed with SimdRelease().

functions.name: SimdDetectionPrepare
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionPrepare(void * hid)
functions.description: Prepares the hidden classifier cascade for detection with the current integral images. Must be called before any SimdDetection*Detect* functions.
requirements: hid must be a valid pointer returned by SimdDetectionInit.
Call before detection functions each time integral images change.

functions.name: SimdDetectionHaarDetect32fp
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionHaarDetect32fp(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs HAAR-based detection using 32-bit float evaluation at all points. Writes non-zero markers at dst for positions (left-top corners) where objects are detected. Optional mask and bounding box restrict the search.
requirements: Call SimdDetectionPrepare(hid) before using.
hid must be a valid hidden cascade.
mask is optional; if provided it must be 8-bit and same geometry as the scan map; maskStride in bytes.
Bounding box (left, top, right, bottom) restricts detection region for the scanning window’s top-left corner.
dst is 8-bit output map; dstStride in bytes.

functions.name: SimdDetectionHaarDetect32fi
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionHaarDetect32fi(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs HAAR-based detection using 32-bit float evaluation at only even positions (improved performance at reduced resolution). Outputs markers in dst similarly to 32fp.
requirements: Same as SimdDetectionHaarDetect32fp; scans on even grid only.
Call SimdDetectionPrepare first.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLbpDetect32fp
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionLbpDetect32fp(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs LBP-based detection using 32-bit float evaluation at all points. Outputs detection markers at dst.
requirements: Call SimdDetectionPrepare before using.
Provide optional mask and bounding box as in HAAR detect.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLbpDetect32fi
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionLbpDetect32fi(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs LBP-based detection using 32-bit float evaluation at even positions. Outputs markers in dst.
requirements: Same preconditions as LBP 32fp; scans on even grid.
Call SimdDetectionPrepare first.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLbpDetect16ip
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionLbpDetect16ip(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs LBP-based detection using 16-bit integer evaluation at all points (p = process all points). Outputs detection markers in dst.
requirements: hid configured with int16 support (see SimdDetectionInit int16 flag and SimdDetectionInfo).
Call SimdDetectionPrepare first.
Optional mask/bbox as above.

functions.name: SimdDetectionLbpDetect16ii
functions.signature: void SimdDetectionLbpDetect16ii(const void * hid, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride)
functions.description: Runs LBP-based detection using 16-bit integer evaluation at even positions (i = even grid). Outputs detection markers in dst.
requirements: Same as SimdDetectionLbpDetect16ip, but scans on even grid.
Call SimdDetectionPrepare first.

functions.name: SimdDrawLine
functions.signature: void SimdDrawLine(uint8_t* canvas, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channels, ptrdiff_t x1, ptrdiff_t y1, ptrdiff_t x2, ptrdiff_t y2, const uint8_t* color, size_t lineWidth)
functions.description: Draws a colored line of specified width from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) on an image with a given number of channels (8-bit per channel). Color array has length = channels.
requirements: canvas must point to an image buffer with given geometry and channels (1..4).
stride is bytes per row.
color must have at least 'channels' bytes.
lineWidth >= 1.
Coordinates may be outside; implementation clips to canvas.

functions.name: SimdDrawRectangle
functions.signature: void SimdDrawRectangle(uint8_t* canvas, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channels, ptrdiff_t left, ptrdiff_t top, ptrdiff_t right, ptrdiff_t bottom, const uint8_t* color, size_t lineWidth)
functions.description: Draws a rectangular outline with the given color and line width onto the image. The rectangle is specified by left,top,right,bottom.
requirements: canvas image: 8-bit per channel with 'channels' in [1..4].
color array length equals channels.
lineWidth >= 1.
Coordinates should delineate a valid box; clipping may occur at edges.

functions.name: SimdFill
functions.signature: void SimdFill(uint8_t * dst, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t pixelSize, uint8_t value)
functions.description: Fills an image region with a constant byte value across all pixel bytes. Works for arbitrary pixel sizes (value repeated across pixel).
requirements: dst points to destination image; width/height in pixels; pixelSize in bytes.
stride is bytes per row.
No alignment constraints documented.

functions.name: SimdFillFrame
functions.signature: void SimdFillFrame(uint8_t * dst, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t pixelSize, size_t frameLeft, size_t frameTop, size_t frameRight, size_t frameBottom, uint8_t value)
functions.description: Fills the entire image except the interior region bounded by the given frame rectangle with a constant byte value. The bounded region is excluded.
requirements: dst image geometry given by width/height and pixelSize.
frame sides must describe a rectangle within image bounds (implementation expects valid).
stride in bytes.

functions.name: SimdFillBgr
functions.signature: void SimdFillBgr(uint8_t * dst, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t blue, uint8_t green, uint8_t red)
functions.description: Fills a 24-bit BGR image with the provided B,G,R color.
requirements: dst is 24-bit BGR image of given size; stride in bytes.
blue/green/red each 0..255.

functions.name: SimdFillBgra
functions.signature: void SimdFillBgra(uint8_t * dst, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t blue, uint8_t green, uint8_t red, uint8_t alpha)
functions.description: Fills a 32-bit BGRA image with the provided B,G,R,A color.
requirements: dst is 32-bit BGRA; stride in bytes; width/height in pixels.
Color components in [0..255].

functions.name: SimdFillPixel
functions.signature: void SimdFillPixel(uint8_t * dst, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * pixel, size_t pixelSize)
functions.description: Fills an image with a provided pixel value (byte pattern of length pixelSize). Useful for arbitrary formats (1..4 bytes per pixel).
requirements: pixelSize must be in range [1..4] (per docs).
dst image size per width/height and stride.
pixel must point to at least pixelSize bytes.

functions.name: SimdFill32f
functions.signature: void SimdFill32f(float * dst, size_t size, const float * value)
functions.description: Fills a float array with a given value; if value is NULL, fills with 0.0f.
requirements: dst must point to at least 'size' floats.
value may be NULL to imply zero.

functions.name: SimdFloat32ToBFloat16
functions.signature: void SimdFloat32ToBFloat16(const float* src, size_t size, uint16_t* dst)
functions.description: Converts an array of 32-bit floats to bfloat16 (16-bit brain floating-point) representation.
requirements: src points to at least 'size' floats; dst to at least 'size' uint16 elements.

functions.name: SimdBFloat16ToFloat32
functions.signature: void SimdBFloat16ToFloat32(const uint16_t* src, size_t size, float* dst)
functions.description: Converts an array of bfloat16 to 32-bit floats.
requirements: src and dst need at least 'size' elements.
No special alignment documented.

functions.name: SimdFloat32ToFloat16
functions.signature: void SimdFloat32ToFloat16(const float * src, size_t size, uint16_t * dst)
functions.description: Converts an array of FP32 to IEEE 16-bit float (half).
requirements: src and dst must have at least 'size' elements.
Range/NaN handling per library implementation.

functions.name: SimdFloat16ToFloat32
functions.signature: void SimdFloat16ToFloat32(const uint16_t * src, size_t size, float * dst)
functions.description: Converts an array of IEEE 16-bit floats (half) to FP32.
requirements: src and dst must have at least 'size' elements.

functions.name: SimdFontInit
functions.signature: SIMD_API void* SimdFontInit();
functions.description: Creates and returns a font rendering context used by SimdFont* APIs (resize/measure/draw). Returns NULL on error. The returned context must be released via SimdRelease.
requirements: Caller must check returned pointer for NULL before use.
The context must later be released with SimdRelease to avoid leaks.
Only use the context with SimdFontResize, SimdFontHeight, SimdFontMeasure, SimdFontDraw.

functions.name: SimdFontResize
functions.signature: SIMD_API SimdBool SimdFontResize(void * context, size_t height);
functions.description: Sets the current font height for the given font context.
requirements: context must be a valid font context created by SimdFontInit and not yet released.
height is the new font height (no explicit bounds specified).
Return value indicates success (SimdTrue) or failure (SimdFalse).

functions.name: SimdFontHeight
functions.signature: SIMD_API size_t SimdFontHeight(void* context);
functions.description: Returns the current font height of the specified font context.
requirements: context must be a valid font context created by SimdFontInit and not yet released.

functions.name: SimdFontMeasure
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdFontMeasure(void* context, const char* text, size_t* width, size_t* height);
functions.description: Measures pixel dimensions of the rectangle required to draw the given text using the provided font context.
requirements: context must be a valid font context created by SimdFontInit and not yet released.
text must point to a valid, null-terminated string (encoding unspecified).
width and height must be non-null pointers to receive the measured size.

functions.name: SimdFontDraw
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdFontDraw(void* context, uint8_t* canvas, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channels, const char* text, size_t left, size_t top, const uint8_t* color);
functions.description: Renders the specified text onto the canvas image buffer at the given position using the font context and color.
requirements: context must be a valid font context created by SimdFontInit and not yet released.
canvas must point to an image buffer large enough for width x height x channels with row size stride bytes; it will be modified in place.
stride must be >= width * channels (in bytes).
channels must match the canvas format (exact supported channel counts not specified; typical values 1..4).
text must be a valid, null-terminated string.
left/top specify the starting position in pixels; caller must ensure text fits within the canvas or accept clipping.
color must point to an array of length = channels (per-channel 8-bit) specifying draw color.

functions.name: SimdSquaredDifferenceSum16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdSquaredDifferenceSum16f(const uint16_t * a, const uint16_t * b, size_t size, float * sum);
functions.description: Computes sum of squared differences between two BF16 arrays and stores the FP32 result in sum.
requirements: a and b must point to BF16 arrays of length size.
sum must be a valid pointer to receive the FP32 result; its initial content is ignored.
size is the number of elements to process and must be >= 0 (no explicit upper bound).

functions.name: SimdCosineDistance16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdCosineDistance16f(const uint16_t * a, const uint16_t * b, size_t size, float * distance);
functions.description: Computes cosine distance (1 - cosine similarity) between two BF16 vectors of length size and returns the FP32 distance.
requirements: a and b must point to BF16 arrays of length size.
distance must be a valid pointer to store the FP32 result.
If either vector is all zeros, behavior of normalization is not detailed; caller should avoid zero-norm vectors when possible.

functions.name: SimdCosineDistancesMxNa16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdCosineDistancesMxNa16f(size_t M, size_t N, size_t K, const uint16_t * const * A, const uint16_t * const * B, float * distances);
functions.description: Computes pairwise cosine distances between M BF16 vectors in A and N BF16 vectors in B (each length K). Results written as an MxN FP32 matrix in row-major order distances[i*N + j].
requirements: A must be an array of M pointers, each pointing to a BF16 array of length K.
B must be an array of N pointers, each pointing to a BF16 array of length K.
distances must point to a buffer with at least M*N FP32 elements.
M, N, K must be consistent with provided arrays. Avoid zero-norm vectors to prevent undefined normalization.

functions.name: SimdCosineDistancesMxNp16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdCosineDistancesMxNp16f(size_t M, size_t N, size_t K, const uint16_t* A, const uint16_t* B, float* distances);
functions.description: Computes pairwise cosine distances between M contiguous BF16 vectors in A and N contiguous BF16 vectors in B (each length K). Outputs an MxN FP32 matrix distances[i*N + j].
requirements: A must point to a contiguous buffer of size M*K (BF16).
B must point to a contiguous buffer of size N*K (BF16).
distances must have capacity for M*N FP32 values.
Avoid zero-norm vectors when possible; undefined normalization behavior otherwise.

functions.name: SimdVectorNormNa16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdVectorNormNa16f(size_t N, size_t K, const uint16_t* const* A, float* norms);
functions.description: Computes Euclidean norms (L2) for N BF16 vectors provided as pointer array A (each length K). Results are FP32 norms[j].
requirements: A must be an array of N pointers, each pointing to a BF16 array of length K.
norms must have at least N FP32 entries.

functions.name: SimdVectorNormNp16f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdVectorNormNp16f(size_t N, size_t K, const uint16_t* A, float* norms);
functions.description: Computes Euclidean norms (L2) for N contiguous BF16 vectors (each of length K) packed in A. Results are FP32 norms[j].
requirements: A must contain N*K BF16 elements laid out row-major (vector-major) with stride K.
norms must have capacity for N FP32 values.

functions.name: SimdFloat32ToUint8
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdFloat32ToUint8(const float * src, size_t size, const float * lower, const float * upper, uint8_t * dst);
functions.description: Converts FP32 array to uint8 by clamping each value to [lower, upper] and linearly mapping to 0..255.
requirements: src must have at least size FP32 values.
lower and upper must be valid pointers to scalar bounds (single values) used for all elements; lower < upper is required for meaningful results.
dst must have capacity for size bytes.
Values outside [lower, upper] are saturated before mapping.

functions.name: SimdUint8ToFloat32
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdUint8ToFloat32(const uint8_t * src, size_t size, const float * lower, const float * upper, float * dst);
functions.description: Converts uint8 values to FP32 via linear mapping: dst[i] = src[i]*(upper - lower)/255 + lower.
requirements: src must have at least size uint8 values.
lower and upper must be valid pointers to scalar bounds; typically lower < upper.
dst must have capacity for size FP32 values.

functions.name: SimdCosineDistance32f
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdCosineDistance32f(const float * a, const float * b, size_t size, float * distance);
functions.description: Computes cosine distance between two FP32 vectors of length size.
requirements: a and b must each have at least size FP32 elements.
distance must be a valid pointer to store the result.
Avoid zero-norm vectors to prevent undefined normalization.

functions.name: SimdGaussianBlur3x3
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGaussianBlur3x3(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a separable 3x3 Gaussian blur (kernel with weights [[1,2,1],[2,4,2],[1,2,1]]/16) to an image with 8-bit per channel. Supports formats with channelCount in {1,2,3,4}.
requirements: src and dst images must have the same width, height, and channelCount (8-bit per channel).
srcStride and dstStride are in bytes; must meet buffer layout for given width and channelCount.
width and height define the processed region; border handling follows the provided formula; ensure buffers are large enough.

functions.name: SimdGaussianBlurInit
functions.signature: SIMD_API void* SimdGaussianBlurInit(size_t width, size_t height, size_t channels, const float * sigma, const float* epsilon);
functions.description: Creates a Gaussian blur filter context for images of fixed size and channel count; precomputes normalized 1D Gaussian weights based on sigma (and epsilon for truncation). Returns NULL on error. Use with SimdGaussianBlurRun and release via SimdRelease.
requirements: width, height, channels must match the images you will process; channels must be in [1..4].
sigma must be non-null and > 0.000001.
epsilon may be NULL (defaults to 0.001) or > 0.000001.
Return must be checked for NULL and freed with SimdRelease.

functions.name: SimdGaussianBlurRun
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGaussianBlurRun(const void* filter, const uint8_t* src, size_t srcStride, uint8_t* dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Runs Gaussian blur on src into dst using a filter context created by SimdGaussianBlurInit. Uses precomputed 1D weights for a 2D convolution.
requirements: filter must be a valid context from SimdGaussianBlurInit (not yet released).
src and dst must match width, height, channels used to create the filter; both are 8-bit per channel.
srcStride and dstStride are row sizes in bytes.

functions.name: SimdGemm32fNN
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGemm32fNN(size_t M, size_t N, size_t K, const float * alpha, const float * A, size_t lda, const float * B, size_t ldb, const float * beta, float * C, size_t ldc);
functions.description: Performs FP32 general matrix multiplication with no transposes: C = alpha*A*B + beta*C, where A is MxK, B is KxN, C is MxN. Supports multithreading via library settings.
requirements: alpha and beta must be valid pointers to scalar multipliers.
A must have dimensions M x K with leading dimension lda >= max(1,K).
B must have dimensions K x N with leading dimension ldb >= max(1,N).
C must have dimensions M x N with leading dimension ldc >= max(1,N).
M, N, K must be consistent with provided buffers. Undefined behavior if pointers overlap improperly.

functions.name: SimdGemm32fNT
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGemm32fNT(size_t M, size_t N, size_t K, const float * alpha, const float * A, size_t lda, const float * B, size_t ldb, const float * beta, float * C, size_t ldc);
functions.description: Performs FP32 GEMM with B transposed: C = alpha*A*Trans(B) + beta*C, where A is MxK, B is NxK (since using Trans(B)), C is MxN.
requirements: alpha and beta must be valid pointers to scalar multipliers.
A must be M x K with lda >= max(1,K).
B must be N x K (to be transposed) with ldb >= max(1,K).
C must be M x N with ldc >= max(1,N).
M, N, K must be consistent. Avoid invalid overlaps.

functions.name: SimdGrayToBgr
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGrayToBgr(const uint8_t *gray, size_t width, size_t height, size_t grayStride, uint8_t *bgr, size_t bgrStride);
functions.description: Converts an 8-bit grayscale image to 24-bit BGR by replicating the gray value across B,G,R channels.
requirements: gray must point to an 8-bit grayscale image of size width x height with row size grayStride bytes.
bgr must have capacity for height rows of width*3 bytes each with bgrStride stride.
Input and output must have the same dimensions.

functions.name: SimdGrayToBgra
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGrayToBgra(const uint8_t *gray, size_t width, size_t height, size_t grayStride, uint8_t *bgra, size_t bgraStride, uint8_t alpha);
functions.description: Converts an 8-bit grayscale image to 32-bit BGRA with a uniform alpha channel value.
requirements: gray must point to an 8-bit grayscale image of size width x height with row size grayStride.
bgra must have capacity for width*4 bytes per row with bgraStride stride.
alpha is the value for the A channel for all pixels.
Dimensions must match.

functions.name: SimdGrayToY
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdGrayToY(const uint8_t* gray, size_t grayStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t* y, size_t yStride);
functions.description: Copies an 8-bit gray image to an 8-bit Y plane (grayscale to YUV Y component).
requirements: gray and y must be distinct or may alias safely (effectively copy); both have same dimensions width x height.
grayStride and yStride are in bytes and must be >= width.

functions.name: SimdAbsSecondDerivativeHistogram
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdAbsSecondDerivativeHistogram(const uint8_t * src, size_t width, size_t height, size_t stride, size_t step, size_t indent, uint32_t * histogram);
functions.description: Computes a histogram (256 bins) of max(abs second-derivative) metric per pixel using offsets ±step in x and y, excluding a border of width indent.
requirements: src must point to an 8-bit gray image with given width, height, stride.
histogram must point to an array of at least 256 uint32_t elements; it will be updated (not stated if cleared; caller should zero-initialize if needed).
width and height must be large enough to allow excluding indent border and ±step accesses (caller must choose step and indent accordingly).

functions.name: SimdHistogram
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHistogram(const uint8_t * src, size_t width, size_t height, size_t stride, uint32_t * histogram);
functions.description: Computes the 256-bin histogram of an 8-bit grayscale image.
requirements: src must be an 8-bit gray image with dimensions width x height and given stride.
histogram must point to an array of 256 uint32_t; caller should initialize it to zero if cumulative behavior is not desired.

functions.name: SimdHistogramMasked
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHistogramMasked(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, uint8_t index, uint32_t * histogram);
functions.description: Computes a 256-bin histogram of src for pixels where mask==index.
requirements: src and mask are 8-bit gray images of the same width and height with respective strides.
histogram must have 256 uint32_t elements; initialize as needed.
index selects which mask value to include.

functions.name: SimdHistogramConditional
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHistogramConditional(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * mask, size_t maskStride, uint8_t value, SimdCompareType compareType, uint32_t * histogram);
functions.description: Computes a 256-bin histogram of src for pixels where compare(mask, value) is true. compare is determined by compareType (==, !=, >, >=, <, <=).
requirements: src and mask are 8-bit gray images of same dimensions and respective strides.
histogram must have 256 uint32_t entries; initialize as needed.
compareType must be a valid SimdCompareType value.

functions.name: SimdNormalizedColors
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdNormalizedColors(const uint32_t * histogram, uint8_t * colors);
functions.description: Creates a normalized color map (transfer function) from a 256-bin histogram into 256 uint8 values (exact normalization details not elaborated; typically scales to [0,255]).
requirements: histogram must point to 256 uint32_t values.
colors must point to a buffer of at least 256 uint8 values.

functions.name: SimdChangeColors
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdChangeColors(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const uint8_t * colors, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a color map (lookup table) to an 8-bit gray image: dst[x,y] = colors[src[x,y]].
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray images with same width and height.
colors must have 256 uint8 entries (LUT).
srcStride and dstStride are in bytes.

functions.name: SimdNormalizeHistogram
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdNormalizeHistogram(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Performs histogram normalization (contrast normalization) on an 8-bit gray image. Exact normalization method per library implementation.
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray images with the same dimensions.
srcStride and dstStride are row sizes in bytes.
The operation reads src and writes dst; caller ensures buffers are valid.

functions.name: SimdHogDirectionHistograms
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHogDirectionHistograms(const uint8_t * src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t cellX, size_t cellY, size_t quantization, float * histograms);
functions.description: Computes per-cell HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) direction histograms of an 8-bit gray image. Each cell is cellX by cellY; quantization is the number of bins (even).
requirements: src is an 8-bit gray image of size width x height with given stride.
width must be a multiple of cellX; height must be a multiple of cellY.
quantization must be even; number of output histograms is (width/cellX)*(height/cellY), each with quantization bins.
histograms must have capacity for (width/cellX)*(height/cellY)*quantization FP32 values.

functions.name: SimdHogExtractFeatures
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHogExtractFeatures(const uint8_t * src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, float * features);
functions.description: Extracts HOG features for an 8-bit gray image using 8x8 cells and 2x2 blocks, yielding 31 features per cell.
requirements: src is an 8-bit gray image with dimensions width x height and given stride.
width and height must be multiples of 8, with minimal values 16.
features must have capacity of (width/8)*(height/8)*31 FP32 elements.

functions.name: SimdHogDeinterleave
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHogDeinterleave(const float * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t count, float ** dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Separates an interleaved FP32 image with 'count' channels/planes into separate planar outputs.
requirements: src points to an interleaved FP32 image with width x height and count interleaved channels, row stride srcStride (in floats).
dst is an array of count pointers, each pointing to a plane buffer; each plane has size height x width with row stride dstStride (in floats).
All plane buffers must be allocated and large enough.

functions.name: SimdHogFilterSeparable
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdHogFilterSeparable(const float * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, const float * rowFilter, size_t rowSize, const float * colFilter, size_t colSize, float * dst, size_t dstStride, int add);
functions.description: Applies a separable 2D filter to a FP32 image: convolution with rowFilter and colFilter; either writes or accumulates into dst depending on add flag.
requirements: src is a FP32 image width x height with srcStride (floats per row).
rowFilter length is rowSize; colFilter length is colSize; caller must ensure width >= rowSize and height >= colSize.
dst is a FP32 image with dstStride (floats per row), same spatial size as the valid convolution output (implementation uses same width/height, border treatment per doc).
add==0 to overwrite dst; add!=0 to accumulate into dst.

functions.name: SimdImageSaveToMemory
functions.signature: SIMD_API uint8_t* SimdImageSaveToMemory(const uint8_t* src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, SimdPixelFormatType format, SimdImageFileType file, int quality, size_t * size);
functions.description: Encodes an image in memory into given file format and returns a newly allocated buffer containing the encoded file. The buffer must be freed with SimdFree.
requirements: src must point to image data in the specified pixel format (Gray8, Bgr24, Bgra32, Rgb24, Rgba32).
stride is the row size in bytes; must match format and width.
file selects the file format; SimdImageFileUndefined enables auto selection by implementation.
quality is respected only by formats that support it (e.g., JPEG).
size must be a valid pointer to receive the output buffer size in bytes.
On success returns non-NULL pointer; caller must free with SimdFree.

functions.name: SimdImageSaveToFile
functions.signature: SIMD_API SimdBool SimdImageSaveToFile(const uint8_t* src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, SimdPixelFormatType format, SimdImageFileType file, int quality, const char * path);
functions.description: Saves an image to a file in the given format.
requirements: src must point to image data of the specified format (Gray8, Bgr24, Bgra32, Rgb24, Rgba32).
stride must match width and format in bytes.
file may be SimdImageFileUndefined to auto-choose by extension or implementation.
quality applicable to formats like JPEG.
path must be a valid writable location.
Returns SimdTrue on success; SimdFalse on failure.

functions.name: SimdNv12SaveAsJpegToMemory
functions.signature: SIMD_API uint8_t* SimdNv12SaveAsJpegToMemory(const uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, const uint8_t* uv, size_t uvStride, size_t width, size_t height, SimdYuvType yuvType, int quality, size_t* size);
functions.description: Encodes an NV12 image (Y plane + interleaved UV plane) to JPEG and returns an allocated buffer containing the JPEG file. Must free with SimdFree.
requirements: width and height must be even numbers (NV12).
y points to Y plane (width x height), yStride is row size in bytes.
uv points to interleaved UV plane (width/2 x height/2 samples, 2 bytes per 2x2 block horizontally), uvStride is row size in bytes.
yuvType currently supports only SimdYuvTrect871 (per docs).
quality controls JPEG quality; size receives output buffer length.
Returns NULL on error; free returned buffer with SimdFree.

functions.name: SimdYuv420pSaveAsJpegToMemory
functions.signature: SIMD_API uint8_t* SimdYuv420pSaveAsJpegToMemory(const uint8_t* y, size_t yStride, const uint8_t* u, size_t uStride, const uint8_t* v, size_t vStride, size_t width, size_t height, SimdYuvType yuvType, int quality, size_t* size);
functions.description: Encodes a YUV420P image to JPEG and returns an allocated buffer containing the JPEG file. Must free with SimdFree.
requirements: width and height must be even numbers (4:2:0).
y is width x height; u and v are width/2 x height/2; corresponding strides provided.
yuvType currently supports only SimdYuvTrect871 (per docs).
quality controls JPEG quality; size receives the encoded size.
Returns NULL on error; free with SimdFree.

functions.name: SimdImageLoadFromMemory
functions.signature: SIMD_API uint8_t* SimdImageLoadFromMemory(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, size_t* stride, size_t* width, size_t* height, SimdPixelFormatType * format);
functions.description: Decodes an image from a memory buffer into raw pixel data. Returns a newly allocated pixel buffer and fills out stride, width, height, and potentially format (either requested or source format). The returned buffer must be freed via SimdFree.
requirements: data must point to an encoded image of length size bytes.
stride, width, height must be non-null output pointers.
format: if set to SimdPixelFormatNone on input, the decoder may choose the image’s native format; otherwise it attempts conversion to the specified format (Gray8, Bgr24, Bgra32, Rgb24, Rgba32).
Returns NULL on error; free returned buffer with SimdFree.

functions.name: SimdImageLoadFromFile
functions.signature: SIMD_API uint8_t* SimdImageLoadFromFile(const char* path, size_t* stride, size_t* width, size_t* height, SimdPixelFormatType * format);
functions.description: Loads and decodes an image from a file into raw pixel data. Returns a newly allocated buffer and outputs stride, width, height, and format. The returned buffer must be freed with SimdFree.
requirements: path must refer to a readable image file.
stride, width, height must be non-null output pointers.
format behavior as in SimdImageLoadFromMemory (SimdPixelFormatNone to keep source format or specify desired format).
Returns NULL on error; free returned buffer with SimdFree.

functions.name: SimdInt16ToGray
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdInt16ToGray(const uint8_t * src, size_t width, size_t height, size_t srcStride, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Converts a single-channel 16-bit signed image to an 8-bit gray image by saturating values to [0,255]. Note: src is declared as uint8_t* but represents 16-bit signed data (per comment); interpretation is implementation-defined; typical layout is 2 bytes per pixel.
requirements: src must contain a single-channel 16-bit signed image of size width x height with row size srcStride bytes (likely 2*width).
dst must be an 8-bit gray image buffer with row size dstStride bytes.
Both images must have the same width and height.

functions.name: SimdIntegral
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdIntegral(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * sum, size_t sumStride, uint8_t * sqsum, size_t sqsumStride, uint8_t * tilted, size_t tiltedStride, SimdPixelFormatType sumFormat, SimdPixelFormatType sqsumFormat);
functions.description: Computes integral images (sum, squared sum, and optional tilted sum) of an 8-bit gray input. Output integral images are (width+1) x (height+1).
requirements: src is 8-bit gray with given width, height, srcStride.
sum must point to a (width+1) x (height+1) buffer with format SimdPixelFormatInt32 (sumFormat must be SimdPixelFormatInt32); sumStride is in bytes.
sqsum can be NULL; if provided, it must be (width+1) x (height+1) and sqsumFormat must be SimdPixelFormatInt32 or SimdPixelFormatDouble; sqsumStride in bytes.
tilted can be NULL; if provided, it must be (width+1) x (height+1) with format SimdPixelFormatInt32; tiltedStride in bytes.
All provided output buffers must be allocated sufficiently before call.

functions.name: SimdInterleaveUv
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdInterleaveUv(const uint8_t * u, size_t uStride, const uint8_t * v, size_t vStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * uv, size_t uvStride);
functions.description: Interleaves planar 8-bit U and V into a single 16-bit-per-pixel UV interleaved image (NV12-like UV plane).
requirements: u and v are 8-bit planes of same width and height; their strides are in bytes.
uv must have capacity for width*2 bytes per row (interleaved UV), with uvStride stride.
Input and output dimensions must match.

functions.name: SimdInterleaveBgr
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdInterleaveBgr(const uint8_t * b, size_t bStride, const uint8_t * g, size_t gStride, const uint8_t * r, size_t rStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * bgr, size_t bgrStride);
functions.description: Interleaves 8-bit planar B, G, R channels into a 24-bit BGR image.
requirements: b, g, r are 8-bit planar images with same width and height and their respective strides.
bgr must be a 24-bit interleaved buffer with bgrStride bytes per row (>= 3*width).

functions.name: SimdInterleaveBgra
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdInterleaveBgra(const uint8_t * b, size_t bStride, const uint8_t * g, size_t gStride, const uint8_t * r, size_t rStride, const uint8_t * a, size_t aStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * bgra, size_t bgraStride);
functions.description: Interleaves 8-bit planar B, G, R, A channels into a 32-bit BGRA image.
requirements: b, g, r, a are 8-bit planes with identical dimensions and strides as provided.
bgra must be a 32-bit interleaved buffer with bgraStride bytes per row (>= 4*width).

functions.name: SimdLaplace
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdLaplace(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Computes the Laplacian filter response of an 8-bit gray image; writes 16-bit signed results (per docs) into dst. Note: signature uses uint8_t* for dst but documentation specifies 16-bit integer output; destination buffer is treated as 16-bit image.
requirements: src must be an 8-bit gray image with given width, height, srcStride.
dst must be a buffer for a 16-bit integer image with dstStride in bytes (likely 2*width).
Input and output dimensions must match.

functions.name: SimdLaplaceAbs
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdLaplaceAbs(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Computes the absolute value of the Laplacian filter; outputs 16-bit integer values (per docs) to dst. Signature uses uint8_t* for dst but destination is effectively 16-bit.
requirements: src: 8-bit gray image.
dst: 16-bit integer buffer sized for width x height; dstStride in bytes.
Dimensions must match.

functions.name: SimdLaplaceAbsSum
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdLaplaceAbsSum(const uint8_t * src, size_t stride, size_t width, size_t height, uint64_t * sum);
functions.description: Accumulates the sum of absolute Laplacian responses over an 8-bit gray image; returns the sum via pointer.
requirements: src: 8-bit gray image with given stride.
sum must be a valid pointer to receive the 64-bit result.

functions.name: SimdLbpEstimate
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdLbpEstimate(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Computes Local Binary Patterns (LBP) image from an 8-bit gray input and writes an 8-bit result image of same size.
requirements: src and dst are 8-bit gray images with same dimensions.
Strides are in bytes; buffers must be valid for width x height.

functions.name: SimdMeanFilter3x3
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdMeanFilter3x3(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a 3x3 mean (box) filter to an image with 8-bit per channel. Supports channelCount in {1,2,3,4}.
requirements: src and dst images have identical dimensions and channelCount (8-bit per channel).
Strides are bytes per row.
channelCount must match the image format; width/height must be valid.

functions.name: SimdMedianFilterRhomb3x3
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdMedianFilterRhomb3x3(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a median filter with a rhombus-shaped 3x3 neighborhood to an 8-bit per channel image (channelCount 1..4).
requirements: src and dst same dimensions and channelCount.
Strides in bytes; buffers must be valid.

functions.name: SimdMedianFilterRhomb5x5
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdMedianFilterRhomb5x5(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a median filter with a rhombus 5x5 neighborhood to an image with 8-bit per channel (channelCount 1..4).
requirements: src/dst dimensions match; channelCount 1..4.
Strides in bytes; buffers sufficient.

functions.name: SimdMedianFilterSquare3x3
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdMedianFilterSquare3x3(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a 3x3 square-window median filter to an 8-bit per channel image (channelCount 1..4).
requirements: src/dst dimensions and channelCount must match; strides valid.

functions.name: SimdMedianFilterSquare5x5
functions.signature: SIMD_API void SimdMedianFilterSquare5x5(const uint8_t * src, size_t srcStride, size_t width, size_t height, size_t channelCount, uint8_t * dst, size_t dstStride);
functions.description: Applies a 5x5 square-window median filter to an 8-bit per channel image (channelCount 1..4).
requirements: src/dst dimensions and channelCount must match; strides valid.
